In addition, at high levels, distortion may occur because the signal crosses the 0 cross point, but it is removed by the MSB correction of the super linear converter. In addition, at the instantaneous peak level (approximately 99.6% or more of the maximum level) that is almost absent in one piece of music, LAMBDA avoids shift calculation and uses the converter's dynamic range to the maximum extent to ensure a wide dynamic range.The digital filter is equipped with a 20-bit 8 x oversampling digital filter. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A CD player with a Lambda S. L. C4D/A converter.The D/A converter is equipped with a 4D/A converter of Lambda S. L. C.Lambda is an abbreviation of LAMBDA (Ladder-from Multiple Bias D/A). It uses a newly developed LSI to divide digital data into two systems, each of which is shifted by applying a digital bias in the + and - directions near the 0 cross point to eliminate the 0 cross distortion in principle.In this method, when the digital data is smaller than the shift amount, there is no value crossing the original 0 cross point, so there is no 0 cross distortion. Furthermore, by adding the two data after D/A conversion, the DC component is removed and the two data are combined. Thus, an analog output with no 0 cross distortion can be obtained. These two data have no MSB inversion and no 0 cross distortion in the combined waveform. Moreover, even if there is an error in any bit, the distortion is reduced to 1/2 by averaging the two signals.In addition, if the digital data is at a level larger than the shift amount, it will cross the original 0 cross point, which may cause distortion. However, this distortion is also removed by the MSB correction of the S. L. C (Super Linear Converter). In addition, when there is no shift operation or only a few times in a single song at the peak level (approximately 99.6% or more of the maximum level), the lambda function stops shifting operations and uses the converter's dynamic range to ensure a wide dynamic range.The DCD 1650 uses a differential amplifier configuration to improve the S/N ratio and distortion factor as well as to enhance the ability to reproduce small signals. Moreover, the output of one side of the lambda processor is delayed by a half period of 8 fs and combined at the output stage of the D/A converter to achieve the same operation as 16 fs. This allows unwanted noise to be shifted to the higher frequency range, and combined with the use of a GIC analog filter to improve the phase characteristics.The digital filter is equipped with an 8 x oversampling digital filter. By raising the sampling frequency by 8 x, the high-frequency noise of 24.1 kHz or higher included in the output of the converter is shifted to the higher range, making it easier to remove with the analog filter.The analog circuits after the D/A converter are designed to be independent on the left and right sides. Moreover, the analog circuits are completely independent on the L/R according to the signal flow, thereby eliminating interference between channels.The power supply section uses a large power transformer and a large-capacity smoothing capacitor.Aluminum extruded material is used for the top cover.Power cord with polarity display is used.Equipped with Denon's own digital pitch commander, the playback pitch of CDs can be changed up to ¥12.0%.This feature allows the digital PLL to adjust the pitch of the CD playback in 0.1% increments.It is equipped with peak search which can find the maximum recording level of the disk with one touch operation.Equipped with a time specifying type time edit function and a 2-segment type auto edit function.It is equipped with a fader function that allows you to fade in / out at your favorite place or fade out at a specified time during performance.It is equipped with up to 20 program plays.Display brightness can be changed to 4 levels.It is equipped with a remote control electric volume that can be used as headphones.There are 2 kinds of variations, black type DCD 1650 and gold type DCD 1650 g.Wireless remote control is included."

However, a very small error in these resistors causes 0 crossing distortion, which is similar to the crossover distortion of a class B amplifier. This distortion occurs regardless of the magnitude of the signal waveform, so it degrades the sound quality especially when the sound is small.The Super Linear Converter consists of a 16-bit high-precision D/A converter and a conversion error detection and correction circuit. First of all, it uses a high-precision and high-stability resistor and adopts a converter system that can easily correct errors to improve basic performance. By damping and floating the die-cast chassis from the main chassis, the influence of external vibrations on the pickup is eliminated.In addition, the pickup is driven together with a fan-shaped trace arm, which adopts the same method as the DN-3000F that is directly driven by a servo motor for driving the pickup.In the center of the rotating system, a direct drive system using a DC servo motor developed for CD players is adopted.The amplifier circuit is configured as a DC amplifier for low distortion and wide dynamic range.The external power transformer eliminates the effect of leakage flux on the power supply.The secondary side of the power transformer is an independent Route 3 for the mechanism drive & servo unit, analog amplifier unit and digital display unit to eliminate interference between each section.The display section uses a computer-controlled centralized display.It is equipped with functions such as direct selection, program performance of up to 15 songs, index selection, intro search, skip monitor, call function, repeat all songs / between 2 points function, quick selection function, timer playback function, etc."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"The first DENON CD player.A 3-spot type laser pickup is used for the pickup part.This method consists of a main laser spot for code detection and two sub laser spots for tracking error detection. The reflected light from these two laser spots for error detection is converted into an electrical signal before entering an error signal amplifier. If tracking is accurate, the output of the error signal amplifier is 0. If there is even a slight difference, the error signal amplifier produces an output as an input difference. This error output goes into a servo circuit and moves the objective lens to correct the position of the main laser spot.In addition, a focus servo system is adopted so that the focus of the focus lens always matches with the accuracy of ¥1 Ï‰ m against the vertical fluctuation of the disk.The signal read by the laser pickup is first amplified by a preamplifier to a level that is easy to process. Then, 0 or 1 is determined by a data straw circuit. Errors are detected and corrected. The signal is rearranged in the order before interleaving. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A CD player with Real 20-bit Ï‰ -S. L. C.Real 20-bit Ï‰ (LAMBDA) -S. L. C is used for the D/A conversion part.LAMBDA stands for Ladder-form Multiple Bias D/A. Using a newly developed LSI, digital data is divided into two systems, each of which is shifted by applying digital bias in plus and minus directions near the 0 cross point, thereby eliminating 0 cross distortion in principle.With this method, when the reproduced digital data is smaller than the shift amount, there is no value crossing the original 0 cross point, so no 0 cross distortion occurs. When the two shifted data are added after D/A conversion, the DC component is removed and the two shifted data are combined. Thus, an analog output with no 0 cross distortion can be obtained. The two data have no MSB inversion, and no 0 cross distortion occurs in the combined waveform. Even if any bit is distorted, the average of the two signals reduces the distortion to 1/2.In addition, when the reproduced digital data is at a level larger than the shift amount, it crosses the original 0 cross point, which may cause distortion. However, in this case, the distortion is removed by the MSB correction of the super linear converter. In addition, when there is a momentary peak level (more than about 99.6% of the maximum level) that is completely absent or only a few times in a piece of music, LAMBDA stops the shift operation and uses the converter's dynamic range to ensure a wide dynamic range.The DDCD 3500 rg uses a 4D/A system instead of the conventional 2D/A converter system, which brings out the performance of the lambda system and greatly improves the SN ratio.The digital filter uses a 20-bit 8 x oversampling digital filter.In the analog circuit, interference between channels is eliminated by making the L/R configuration completely independent of the signal flow.The power supply is equipped with a digital transformer and an analog transformer independently to reduce interference between the digital and analog sections.We also use carefully selected parts such as large electrolytic capacitors for power supply circuits.In order to prevent digital noise from entering the analog circuit, the circuit board is completely isolated.In addition, bus bar lines, which are used only for commercial machines, are used for analog circuits to reduce ground impedance and prevent high frequencies from jumping in.The pickup part is floating by coil spring and low repulsion viscoelastic rubber to eliminate the effect of vibration.In addition, the vibration absorption effect is enhanced by using BMC (bulk molding compound) with large internal loss as a double BMC mechanical base that is used for both the pickup mechanical base and the mechanical chassis.The chassis eliminates the effect of internal vibration by dividing the mechanical part and power supply part, which may cause vibration, and the circuit system, in which the effect of vibration affects sound quality, into two parts by the center partition wall. In addition, the chassis adopts a double structure and the insulator uses sintered alloy to achieve complete vibration isolation.The chassis is fully copper-plated to guard against radio waves and porcelain noise.Uses gold hairline finish front panel and glossy wood cabinet.Equipped with a display dimmer function, you can adjust four levels of brightness : standard, approximately 2/3, approximately 1/3, and all lights off.Equipped with a variable output volume linked to a headphone.It also comes with headphones and a variable output ON/OFF switch.It is equipped with two coaxial and one optical digital outputs.It is equipped with time search, and it is possible to start the music by time designation and repeat performance between 2 points.Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"CD transport using top-loading mechanism.Top loading mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part, and tray part which tends to cause vibration is eliminated.In addition, a special air shield is applied to the door opening, and aluminum die-cast is used for the door to shut out external light.A thorough vibration suppression design has been adopted.First, in order to prevent vibration propagation from the floor, we have adopted a heavy-weight chassis frame made of sand mold casting and an insulator made of a composite material of aluminum and sintered alloy. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A tuner amplifier that integrates a synthesizer tuner with 16-station preset and a pre-main amplifier with MC input.The tuner section uses a synthesizer system.In this system, the reference frequency obtained from the crystal oscillator and the frequency obtained by dividing the local oscillation frequency are compared in phase, and the varicap servocontrol is performed. Therefore, there is no drift of the local frequency due to temperature change, etc., and good and stable reception is possible.A 4-stage varicap and MOS FET are used in the front end to realize high sensitivity reception and improve the interference rejection capability. The intermediate frequency amplifier (IF) section employs a two stage linear phase ceramic filter configuration to reduce distortion. In addition, a new Quadrature detection circuit is used in the detection circuit.The AM tuner is an IF stage that combines a coil with two stages of newly developed 3-terminal type high-selectivity ceramic filters to suppress 9 kHz beat interference.In addition, we have adopted a low-impedance loop type antenna that is resistant to electric-field noise. This antenna is designed to be attached to and detached from the back panel so that it can be installed in a place with good reception.Each 8 FM/AM stations can be selected for memory music. After selecting the desired station, press the memory button and the preset 1 to 8 buttons to store the desired station.Equipped with an automatic tuning function, it automatically searches for the radio wave of the broadcasting station from the lower frequency to the higher frequency by pressing the auto button, stops at the tuning point and searches for the next tuning point by pressing the switch again.Manual tuning is possible by operating the up and down tuning buttons. The reception frequency is displayed on a digital counter, enabling you to catch weak radio waves that cannot be caught by automatic tuning. "Based on the DL 103 and DL 103 s, this MC type cartridge was developed as the culmination of the DL 103 series.The basic structure of the vibration system uses a single point support system common to the DL-103 series.In this system, the cantilever is supported by an extra-fine piano wire (suspension wire) extending from the suspension. In addition, the material of the diamond tip is 0.1 mm square (0.2 mm square for DL-103, 0.15 mm square for DL-103S). This reduces the mass of the vibration system and realizes wide-band reproduction.This wider bandwidth improves crosstalk in the audible frequency band by 2 to 3 dB compared to the DL 103 s. In addition, since the mechanical impedance characteristic in the high frequency band is also improved, the deformation of the sound groove of the record is reduced, and the tracking performance of the sound groove of the needle tip is improved, and low distortion is realized.Since it is compatible with DL-103 and DL-103S, if the same head shell is used, there is no need to readjust the needle pressure and it can be replaced easily."

description:
## Description

"This MC cartridge is based on the DL 103 and has a lighter vibration system and greater compliance.The structure of the vibration system, power generation method, external dimensions, output voltage and electrical impedance are exactly the same as those of the DL-103.The cantilever is supported by an ultra-fine steel wire with a one point support system. In addition, vibration of the needle tip, which is important for stereo playback, in both directions is heavy, and compliance is the same. In addition, even if the needle tip sinks due to needle pressure, the center point of vibration does not change.A cross-shaped armature is used in the armature section to reduce the mass of the cantilever and to make it easy to wind the generator coils of the left and right channels symmetrically.DENON's unique double-structure cantilever is used.In this structure, the high-frequency characteristics can be changed quite freely by the combination of the length of the outer pipe and the inner pipe, and the characteristics can also be controlled by the combination of the material of both pipes and surface treatment.In the DL-103S, a special alloy is used for the cantilever, and the optimum combination of dimensions is adopted. This, combined with the weight reduction of the vibration system, means that the mechanical impedance is reduced not only in the audible frequency range but also from the low frequency range to the ultra-high frequency range. This increases the ability of the needle tip to follow the sound groove and prevents the needle from flying.The proper needle pressure is set at 1.8 ¥0.3g, 0.7g lighter than DL-103. (Chemical Vapor Deposition) method, and have realized uniform and dense boron film surface.This reduces the effective mass of the vibration system to 0.168 mg, minimizes the mechanical impedance in the high-frequency range, and enables faithful and accurate tracing with light needle pressure.Solid diamond special elliptical needle has been adopted for the needle, achieving 0.01 mg or less.The tip of the boron pipe that fixes the needle is tapered and installed in a precise rectangular hole made by laser beam processing.The generator coil uses a rigid resin cross-shaped winding frame to lighten the entire vibration system and to achieve an optimum mass balance, eliminating the characteristic slack caused by split vibration. This winding frame method allows the coil to be wound symmetrically around the vibration system axis, and has the advantage of matching the characteristics of the left and right channels.For the internal structure, rare-earth cobalt magnet and rational yoke structure are adopted in order to obtain a small size and strong magnetic field. In addition, the vibration system is supported by the one point support system proven in the DL-303 and DL-103 series, so that the coil can always be held in the center of the magnetic field, and the generation of strain in the power generation system is kept low."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"While inheriting the design image of the DP 3000, the appearance was made compact, and each part was simplified and the cost was reduced while maintaining the basic performance.A direct drive system is adopted as the drive system.Unlike the belt drive and idler drive systems, the direct drive system does not have a rotational flutter mechanism, so there is no wow transmission or rumble caused by these systems. In addition, the direct drive system can maintain stable performance over a long period of time because there is little wear.The servo circuit uses a speed detection mechanism based on a magnetic recording / reproducing method developed by DENON's station player.In this system, 1000 pulse signals are recorded with a high accuracy of less than 0.01% recording wavelength error using a special method on a magnetic material coated on the inner circumference of the rim of the turntable. These signals are then detected by a magnetic head in close proximity to the magnetic material. A demodulation circuit converts the voltage into a voltage proportional to the rotational speed of the turntable. This voltage is compared with a reference voltage corresponding to the specified speed. The difference voltage is used to control the torque of the motor so that the difference voltage becomes 0, and the turntable is kept at the specified speed by servoing.In addition to the high accuracy of the speed detection signal, the frequency is higher than that of other methods (500 Hz or higher), so it is stable even when the gain of the servo system is increased, and the response is fast and stable servo can be applied even in the region of uneven rotation.For the drive motor, the solid rotor type AC servo developed for direct drive also uses Oter.This motor is the same as that installed in the DP-3000. It has smooth rotation characteristics with less vibration compared to other synchronous motors and DC motors. Moreover, the driving waveform of the motor is also taken into consideration. There is almost no rumble, and the S / N ratio is over 60 dB.The switch adopts a slide system using a cam.The rotational speed can be changed by changing the circuit constant with a switch. This speed selection switch is linked with the power switch and allows you to select the speed and turn the power ON/OFF with one touch operation.The switch uses special high-grade grease used in cameras.Equipped with easy-to-understand built-in flash and flash shutter."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A direct drive turntable that inherits the performance and design of the DP 5000 and pursues cost performance.In the DP 5000, the pulse recorded inside the rim of the turntable is first detected by a magnetic head for speed detection. The pulse signal is amplified and passed through a limiter circuit. A demodulation circuit converts the change in speed into a change in voltage. This voltage is compared with a reference voltage set in advance to achieve the specified speed. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A pre-main amplifier designed with an emphasis on transmission characteristics.In the power amplifier section, all stages are directly connected DC amplifier configuration using discrete transistors. In the output stage, a newly developed 60W class epitaxial planar type fully symmetrical power transistor with little minority carrier accumulation effect and little switching distortion is adopted. The transistor used in the output stage does not change the finish condition between NPN and PNP, and has more reliability due to the symmetry.In addition, a large radiator with high heat radiation effect, a power supply circuit with large current capacity, and a differential amplifier with excellent DC balance are used to expand the transmission frequency band and to reduce low and high frequency distortion.The equalizer section employs a 3-stage direct-coupled E-E feedback type with a low-noise, high-voltage NPN transistor. In particular, a transistor with extremely high collector loss is used for the emitter follower of the final stage. As a result, the maximum output voltage of the equalizer amplifier is flattened to a high frequency range of 20 kHz. As a result, the allowable input of 10 kHz or higher, which had previously been problematic, is greatly improved.By using a carefully selected equalizer element, the RIAA deviation is kept within + 0. 2-0. 3 dB, making the total response of recording / reproducing flat.The tone circuit uses an NFB method with an emitter follower at the front stage.The Bass/Treble control uses a system that allows automatic defeat at the center point to flatten the transmission characteristics when the tone is flat.The speaker is protected by using a protective circuit with fast response speed.In addition, a detection circuit is provided to protect the power transistor.Equipped with a low filter.The speaker terminal has a screw-type structure to ensure reliable contact and reduce contact resistance.The power supply, filter and monitor switch use a new slide system.It has a unified design with the TU-332 FM tuner."

"PMA 390 series pre-main amplifier.It is equipped with HC (High Current) single push-pull circuit which inherits the idea of UHC single push-pull circuit used in high-grade machines.This circuit uses the HC-transistor, which has twice the current supply capability and peak current capability of the conventional transistor, and provides stable musical expression capability.A Schottky barrier diode is used in the rectifying circuit of the power supply section to bring out the capability of the HC single push-pull circuit.This diode has low-noise characteristics due to its high-speed operation and excellent high-current characteristics, enabling powerful and low-noise reproduction.The power transformers for analog and control systems are separated and independent by windings to reduce interference between circuits and eliminate influence on sound quality.In addition, a dedicated transformer is installed for standby of remote power off to reduce power consumption during standby.The internal layout uses S. L. D. C. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a super equalizer to take advantage of the cartridge performance.The basic configuration consists of two amplifiers, an MC/MM super equalizer amplifier and a non-switching A power amplifier. In addition to this simple configuration, a complete DC configuration is adopted from the MC input terminal to the SP output terminal without using a coupling capacitor in the signal path.This fully capacitor-less configuration is realized by installing DENON's direct DC servo system in both the equalizer and power amplifiers to shut out DC drift and achieve the sound quality inherent in DC-configured amplifiers.The EQ section is equipped with a super equalizer for use with cartridges capable of wide-band playback.The amplifier consists of an NF-type DC amplifier with newly developed low-noise dual FET and a CR-type equalizing filter. The first stage is parallel differential amplifier with dual FET of direct DC servo system.As a result, in addition to the ultra-wide range, we have obtained a high gain equivalent to that of a head amplifier for MC. It is also compatible with low-output MC cartridges.In addition, it is equipped with the dual listening mechanism of the cartridge, and not only the switching of MC/MM can be used, but also the comparison trial listening of 2 MC or 2 MM can be operated by the push button on the front panel.The power amplifier section is equipped with a direct DC servo type high gain non-switching A power amplifier.It consists of a low-impedance buffer amplifier with a first stage low-noise FET parallel differential + IC high-speed operational amplifier, a driver stage of a 3-stage differential current mirror, and a high-speed power transistor 2 parallel push-pull output stage. Direct DC servo is applied from the output terminal of the power amplifier to the first stage of the buffer amplifier. In addition, the signal system has been made highly pure by removing all the coupling capacitors from all the signal paths from the input terminal to the speaker terminal for the MC cartridge to make it a complete DC configuration, thereby greatly improving the signal transmission speed.The circuit configuration of the voltage amplification stage of the power amplifier section is such that the influence of the power amplification stage does not reach the voltage amplification stage by making the first stage a three stage current mirror using a low-noise FET and making the impedance low by using a complimentary service emitter follower.The final output stage is a parallel push-pull configuration using a Pc130W power transistor and a direct class A configuration using DENON's original 0 cross linear bias circuit to eliminate switching distortion.The power supply uses a 600 VA class large toroidal transformer, a 66,000 Ï‰ F large capacitor and a fast recovery diode.The first stage of the equalizer amplifier is 2-parallel differential amplification using four low-noise FETs to obtain a high SN ratio. In addition, the cascode bootstrap is used to suppress the increase in distortion caused by the impedance rise in the mid - and high-frequency range in the case of MM cartridges to realize a wide bandwidth.In addition, the MC input has two positions of High and Low to support various cartridges.Equipped with a dual listening mechanism that allows you to freely switch between two cartridges for trial listening.Equipped with wide-band real-time tone control with limited quality degradation.Equipped with high-speed protection circuit."

In addition, high-frequency characteristics are also improved. In addition, a newly developed cascode differential bootstrap and a dual-transistor current mirror circuit are used together in order to reduce potential distortion and noise. In the voltage amplification stage of the next stage, the Darlington local feedback circuit is a class A push-pull circuit, which greatly reduces distortion. The CR-type equalizing filter of the SEPP output stage is driven with low impedance. The CR-type equalizing filter of the SEPP output stage is driven with low impedance. The CR-type equalizing filter is a thoroughly low-impedance type and uses a non-feedback type real-time equalizer system to obtain excellent SN ratio. ## Description

"A top-of-the-line CD/SACD player with Advanced AL24 Processing.Newly developed Advanced AL24 Processing is installed in the reproduction system of PCM signal (CD / digital).In addition to the AL24 Processing Plus, which is a conventional bit extension technology, this circuit greatly improves the amount of information in the time domain by our own high-speed signal detection and processing technology. In addition to data expansion from 16-bit original information to 24-bit data, this circuit performs more fine-grained natural correction processing without losing original data by interpolation of data on the time axis and up-convert sampling using an algorithm developed by our own using large-capacity arithmetic processing devices such as DSP and FPGA.In addition, the digital filter is more adaptable, and it performs optimum filtering operation processing for pulse-response without ringing as well as for pulsatile tone data and attack sound. By this, spatial information such as the subtle nuances of music, the position of the performer, and the width, height and depth of the performance hall (stage) are reproduced more naturally.The mechanism uses an original drive mechanism, and all the controls (signal processing, drive circuit and firmware) are developed in-house to ensure high reliability.The DCD-SA1 uses a long-life brushless motor to cope with SACD playback when the disc rotates at high speed. The motor shaft length is extremely short to suppress vibration, thereby ensuring performance that can withstand high rotation.In addition, in order to absorb all variations, such as the misalignment of the optical axis when the laser beam is irradiated onto the disk, the mechanical flatness of the pickup mechanical base, and the mechanical tilt of the brushless motor shaft, all skew adjustments (tilt correction) are carried out to optimum signal reproduction and playability.The S. V. H. Loader, a hybrid anti-vibration structure using anti-vibration paint and metal plates, has been adopted for the loader mechanism, and a stable disk drive has been realized by the optimum design of the mechanism base floating.The master clock uses an oscillator with an oscillation accuracy of ¥1 ppm or less (at room temperature), which is more accurate than conventional models.By modularizing the circuit block, the influence of load capacity such as the substrate pattern is suppressed, and the oscillation output is extremely stable compared with a general crystal oscillator.In addition, high-precision design is carried out by investing know-how such as the routing of the pattern wiring on the clock substrate and the supply method to each IC. In particular, the physical distance between the clock and the DAC is shortened, and clock design that cannot be obtained only by internal oscillation centered on the DAC is carried out, which suppresses the effect of jitter noise.In addition, the DAC is used as a master and the PCM and DSD decoder LSIs are used as slaves to generate highly accurate clocks and perform D/A conversion.The D/A converter has a 4-DAC configuration. A two channel device is used for one channel to form a differential output circuit. The HOT and COLD circuits are independent of the D/A converter to form a fully differential balance circuit.Unlike the method in which the phase is inverted by the operational amplifier after the output of the D/A converter, there is no delay between HOT and COLD, making the circuit configuration ideal for distortion and sound quality.A differential drive circuit configuration is also used for the unbalanced output circuit.A triple floating structure has been adopted from the transformer base to the power transformer in order to thoroughly prevent vibration of the power transformer.First of all, four kinds of cushioning materials with different resonance frequencies are combined in the chassis mounting part of the transformer base of aluminum sand mold casting to suppress vibration transmission in a wide frequency band. Then, the fixing screw is floated between the transformer base and the transformer case with a fluorine resin washer and cushioning material. Furthermore, the power transformer itself is floated inside the case with a special filler material. In particular, the filling of this transformer is carried out in two stages over a long period of time so that the transformer itself does not touch the case.In addition, high-grade core material and OFC winding are adopted for the transformer body, and S/N and energy sense are improved by arranging the flux of the transformer for digital and audio to cancel each other.In order to suppress the influence of external vibration and internal fine vibration on sound quality, we have adopted a four layer bottom plate structure, cast iron insulator, hybrid structure panel, and vibration-proof design of the substrate.High rigidity is achieved by placing four flat chassis on the bottom plate of the chassis to confine resonance components in the plane direction of the chassis.The cast iron iron insulator, Denon has specified its own carbon content determined by sound quality tuning. In addition, special cushioning materials and natural fibers are sandwiched between the bottom plate to limit the effect of floor vibration over a wide range of frequencies.In addition, vibration analysis is carried out for each of the side, top and rear panels constituting the housing, and different types of members are combined to suppress the resonance frequency of each part. In particular, the top panel has a double-split structure to make the vibration mode more complicated, making it difficult to resonate even by itself.As an anti-vibration measure for the PCB, the transmission of minute vibrations is suppressed by floating the PCB with fluorine-based resin between the chassis and PCB.Equipped with a digital input terminal, it can also be used as a D/A converter.The digital input signal can be sampled at a frequency of up to 192 kHz and can be used as a high-quality D/A converter with the Advanced AL24 Processing.Pure Direct mode is installed.In this mode, the display and digital signal output are turned off. By turning off the high-pulse signal of the display driver circuit, adverse effects on the audio circuit are suppressed.Wireless remote control is included.There were two variations of the DCD-SA1 remote control depending on when it was sold. The RC-992 was listed in the 2004 catalog that was released and the RC-997 was replaced in the February 2005 catalog."

It controls the frequency characteristics outside the audible band even for dense music data and high-frequency continuous sounds, and performs filtering using the optimum algorithm. This enables optimal sound reproduction without the negative effects of aliasing noise and high-frequency response degradation.The mechanism is equipped with DENON's original drive mechanism.The drive motor for this mechanism uses a long-life brushless motor. The drive motor is placed close to the turntable to withstand the high-speed rotation of the SACD, and the motor shaft is designed to be extremely short.In addition, in order to absorb variations in the tilt of the turntable and pickup mechanical base, all skew adjustments (tilt correction) are performed to achieve optimum playability.The loader mechanism uses an S. V. H. loader, which is made of different materials and has enhanced anti-vibration effects. It supports stable data reading along with the optimally designed mechanical base floating.The clock circuit is equipped with a high-precision oscillator with specifications close to those of DCD-SA1.The circuit block of the oscillator is modularized, and stable oscillation accuracy is obtained without being affected by the substrate pattern.In addition, we have adopted a method of supplying each device with a DAC as a master, as in the case of the high-grade equipment. In particular, the most important clock (DSD clock) for SACD playback is supplied to the slave DSD decoder after division generation, and to the master DAC after correcting to the accuracy of the oscillator again to ensure high accuracy. This method realizes playback with less influence of jitter.Both the hot and cold sides of the balanced output receive the output directly from the dedicated D/A converter.Unlike the balanced output by an inverting amplifier, this method does not cause a difference or delay in sound quality between hot and cold, and the circuit configuration is advantageous in noise and sound quality.Unbalanced output is obtained by differential drive from balanced output.The power supply unit has a twin transformer configuration in which the digital and analog systems are completely separated from the power transformer to eliminate mutual interference. In addition, the effect of the transformer itself is minimized by arranging the magnetic flux leakage in the direction to cancel each other.Aluminum casting with excellent vibration damping characteristics is used for the mounting base to the chassis to suppress the vibration of the transformer itself, as well as the influence on each part and vibration from the outside.Thorough anti-vibration measures are taken.Using a flat plate structure of four bottom plates and two top plates, resonance in the plane direction is completely eliminated and s-lead from the outside is also suppressed. In addition, the side panel and rear panel have a two layer structure, and resonance is suppressed by combining different materials.The main chassis has a center mounted mechanism for weight balance, and the entire main chassis is plated with copper to reduce the influence of inductive noise.Sintered alloy insulators are used for the legs.The center of gravity of the set is lowered by using a sintered alloy with high rigidity, high specific gravity and excellent vibration characteristics. In addition, unnecessary vibration is suppressed in a wide frequency band by special cushioning material.It uses high-quality components selected for its track record in developing numerous digital players.In addition, the audio circuit board is floated with fluorine-based resin.Pre Direct Mode is included.This is a mode that turns off the display and digital output. By turning off the pulse signal for driving the display and digital data, the audio signal is not affected.Wireless remote control is included."

## Description

"A CD/HDD music system that can store your CD library on the internal hard disk.You can store CD music on the built-in hard disk.WMA and linear PCM up to 4 x speed, and Linear PCM can be recorded at up to 12 x speed. The number of songs that can be recorded in 4 minutes per song is approximately 10,000 in WMA standard mode, approximately 7,000 in high quality mode, and approximately 900 in Linear PCM.In addition, music files (MP3, WMA, AAC (M4A), linear PCM) saved on a PC can be loaded into the CHR-F103 by using the included PC application software DENON Music Manager.Some types of AAC files may not be played back correctly.It has a Gracenote database that stores music information on CDs on the hard disk.As a result, when a CD song is recorded on the hard disk, the CD song information is automatically registered. Also, new song information such as new songs can be automatically accessed, obtained and recorded to the Gracenote server if you are connected to the Internet via Ethernet.While recording from a CD to your hard disk, you can monitor and play recorded songs, play songs stored on your hard disk, and play other sources, such as Internet radio or USB players, while recording.It has a playlist function.With this function, you can easily search for and play back songs using the search menu automatically created for each genre or artist, or the search menu for recently recorded CDs or recently played songs. You can also create up to 20 playlists of your favorite songs by yourself. You can change the name of the created playlist to create your favorite list.The Narrow Search menu lets you search by Genres, Artists, Albums, and Tracks, and the Search Your Favorite menu lets you search by recently heard songs (auto-registration), recently recorded CDs (auto-registration), and playlists.When searching from a playlist, you can easily search by Character Search or Initial Character Switching Search. In Character Search, enter the first character of the title you want to search, the next character,. to narrow down the titles of the entered characters and display them on the display. In Initial Character Switching Search, you can switch the initial character to A-B-C,. to display a list of titles with the initial character.By using the USB connector (PC Control connector) for connecting to a PC on the back and the included application DENON Music Manager, you can import music files from your PC and manage songs stored on your hard disk on your PC.In this application, you can change the contents of the playlist (change list name, add / delete / delete all songs). In addition, you can display the list of songs on the hard disk and edit the song information.You can import music files from a PC by folder or by file.This application is for Windows XP SP2.You cannot import music protected by DRM, etc. Also, files saved with CHR-F103 cannot be played by other PCs due to DENON original encryption.You can play Internet radio.Access radio stations from a customized list for DENON of the radio station database service VTuner on the Internet.Equipped with a music server function, you can play music files PC can be played on CHR-F103 via LAN.This feature uses The Designed to DLNA Guidelines (D2G) and Windows Media Connect technology, and supports MP3, WAV (LPCM), and WMA audio formats.You can play MP3 or WMA music files by directly connecting a USB player to the USB port on the front panel.A large display compatible with Japanese and Chinese characters is used for the display section.The D/A converter uses a 192 kHz / 24-bitD / A converter.The digital filter uses an 8-times oversampling digital filter.You can play MP3 or WMA audio files burned to CD-R/RW.Equipped with an optical digital output terminal.When you play a CD, you can select two types of playback patterns for repeat play and program playback.By upgrading the system with DRA-F102, operation such as timer playback, auto function, auto power on, etc. is possible.Wireless remote control is included."

description:
## Description

"This is a stereo tape deck that inherits the technology of the DH-710F/DH-610S and newly adopts a direct tension servo.A direct drive capstan system is adopted for the mechanism.The capstan motor uses an outer rotor type AC servo motor with low vibration and smooth rotation. In addition, the capstan motor uses a speed servo system with a high-precision recording detection method to ensure high performance.The capstan diameter and accuracy (roundness) meet broadcasting station standards, and durability and reliability are ensured by applying a hard chromium treatment.Equipped with a newly developed direct tension servo.In this mechanism, the servo arm constantly detects gradual changes in back tension caused by changes in the feed radius on the feed reel side, uneven winding of the tape, and sudden changes in tape tension caused by eccentricity of the reel. The movement of the arm is transmitted directly to the brake band wound around the brake drum for approximately 1 1/4 (approximately 450 degrees) to keep the tape tension constant.For example, when the tape tension is increased, the servo arm moves, the brake band is loosened, the brake pressure is reduced, and feedback acts to keep the tape tension constant. The backspring compensates for changes in the weight of the reel and tape, and changes in the friction coefficient between the brake drum and the brake band due to environmental conditions.This mechanism has the same performance as an electronic tension servo, and we have developed and adopted new materials for brake shoes that are not affected by environmental conditions and aging.The direct tension servo does not damage the tape because it is extremely fast from tension detection to response, the vibration generated by the motor is eliminated because voltage is not applied to the supply side reel motor, and the start-up characteristic of the tape is improved because impedance rollers are not required.Equipped with brake servo.This mechanism not only facilitates tape setting because the servo is activated when the tape is hooked on the roller of the servo arm, but also operates the back-tension servo during running or until the tape stops completely.The servo effect can also be achieved while the power is turned off.By installing a guide roller and scrape filter, minute vibration of the tape is efficiently suppressed, and sound quality with less modulation noise is obtained.The drive mechanism, head, and amplifier are all mounted on a frame made of all-aluminum casting, improving machining accuracy and preventing the entire mechanism from getting out of order, greatly contributing to the improvement of overall characteristics.By adopting a high hardness Permalloy type narrow gap head, the frequency characteristics are improved.In addition, a special shape is adopted in order to reduce the shape effect that causes the expansion of the low frequency range.The power supply for the amplifier section is a high voltage (35 v). In particular, in order to eliminate sound distortion and clip in the recording amplifier, the dynamic margin is provided with a sufficient margin like a professional model, and the margin is provided with more than 10 dB above the saturation level of the tape, which is more than 30 dB above the standard recording level.In addition, the playback amplifier is a 3-stage direct connection type to improve the quality of the playback sound.The microphone input consists of a microphone amplifier with a high dynamic margin of 55 dB relative to the reference recording input level and a microphone attenuator with a 12 dB attenuation.The mixing circuit of the line and microphone contains the same mixing amplifier as the DH-710F/610S.Using a continuously variable bias / equalizer, you can set the bias amount and recording equalizer characteristics to the optimum values according to the tape you are using.The operation control part is a direct function using IC logic.This allows you to move from any operation mode to the next mode without going through a stop. Inside the deck, it automatically checks that the tape has stopped completely before moving to the next operation, so tape safety is not affected.Equipped with Rec mute/Pause mechanism.If you want to create a white space between songs during recording, you can press and hold the Pause button to activate the Rec mute mechanism and create an unrecorded portion for any length of time, which is effective for editing the recording. After that, simply release the Pause button to return to the normal pause (recording standby).An optical sensor type non-contact safety switch has been adopted for the winding side tension arm to improve reliability.Timer recording and playback mechanism is installed.Remote control is possible.You can use headphones from low impedance type to high impedance type.It can be used either horizontally or vertically."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This is a tape deck that has all the technology to aim at a full-scale 38/2 track high performance deck.Direct Drive 2 capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.The two capstan blocks the contact surface between the tape and the head from external (reel side) vibration elements to stabilize the tape running on the head surface. In addition, the DH-710F adopts a direct drive system in which the main capstan is directly connected to an AC motor, and a newly designed direct drive 2 capstan in which the motor shaft and sub-capstan are connected by a special inelastic belt.In addition, the speed servo of the outer rotor capstan motor uses DENON's unique high-precision magnetic recording detection method to achieve excellent wow flutter characteristics.An electronic tension servo is used for both the feed reel motor and the take-up reel motor.By controlling the AC current flowing through the reel motor, the tape tension is kept constant not only during recording and playback but also during fast-forwarding and rewinding, regardless of the reel size or the amount of remaining tape.The 2-capstan system and electronic tension servo improve the basic running characteristics of the wake-up characteristics and wow flutter. In addition, the tape path is shortened by making the distance between the two capstan as close as possible, eliminating the longitudinal vibration and microvibration of the tape as much as possible, and reducing noise caused by FM modulation.The tape is designed to run straight between the left and right tape tension arms except during recording and playback, making it easy to set up the tape and eliminating the need for a tape shifter.In addition, the parts that contact the tape other than the head use a newly designed guide roller. Since all parts are rotating bodies, stable running characteristics can be obtained even when thin tapes such as long play tapes are used.In addition, a one way air damper is used for the left and right tension arms to prevent excessive tension at the start.The capstan shaft is 12 mm of 12 mm according to broadcasting station standards to improve reliability. Moreover, precision processing to the limit increases roundness and hard chrome processing improves durability.Uses Sendust alloy head developed independently for the head part.The use of a broadcasting station head with a wide track width reduces noise, provides excellent recording and playback characteristics with little distortion, and maintains stable performance even in long-term use.In particular, the playhead has been finished with a special shape that reduces the low-frequency bulge due to the shape effect. The shape effect is caused by the shape of the surface where the head comes into contact with the tape. However, by finishing the shape of the head so that the tape gradually separates from the head, the shape effect is minimized.Both the microphone amplifier and the recording amplifier maintain a large margin to enable recording with a wide dynamic range.In addition, it is equipped with a microphone attenuator so that even high-quality live sound sources can be recorded with plenty of time.The frame precision machined aluminum casting integrated frame is used for the frame part.This enables accurate mounting of the head system and the tape running system, suppressing mechanical distortion caused by aging and maintaining initial performance for a long period of time.The bias amount and recording equalizer characteristics are continuously variable, and can be adjusted according to the attached tape-specific BIAS/EQ adjustment table to maximize the recording tape's capabilities.In addition, a high-frequency recording bias (200 kHz for the DF 710 f) is used to improve the S/N ratio and prevent B when recording an FM stereo broadcast transmission.You can easily check the reference playback level by adjusting the playback volume knob to the reference position of the long line.Equipped with a level meter that can be switched between peak level indication and VU indication.Remote control is possible.Can be used horizontally and vertically."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This speaker system was developed through a technical tie-up with Peerless of Denmark.The woofer is made of cone paper coated with a damping agent to control the split resonance in the high frequency range. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A speaker system with designs such as collagen cones and symmetrical layouts.In VS-370, DENON's original collagen cone is used for the vibration plate of the unit.In this diaphragm, collagen fibers are extracted from animal skin by a special chemical treatment and fused with the material of corn paper. This allows the corn paper to maintain rigidity while controlling only internal loss to an appropriate value, and more ideally controls the split resonance region and high-frequency resonance.In addition, by using collagen fibers at the edge part as well, the disturbance of the characteristics at the point where the piston motion is removed is minimized. In addition, the flexibility of the collagen fibers allows the lowest resonance frequency to be lowered, and the split vibration of the cone paper is also controlled, further ensuring the flattening of the frequency band.The all-cone configuration prevents differences in tone quality depending on the receiving band, which tends to occur in a multi-way system. In addition, the directivity and vibration mode are matched to minimize differences in tone quality depending on the reverberation time of the listening room or the position of speakers.The low range is equipped with 30RW11B which is 30 cm cone type woofer.This unit uses a non-prescone paper with collagen fibers fused to the diaphragm and a melamine coated double structure that increases rigidity and expands the piston motor cortex range, controlling sharp peaks that tend to appear in the high range of woofer.The voice coil has a special structure that uses an aluminum bobbin to prevent radial deflection and at the same time improve the heat radiation effect.The magnetic circuit uses an Alnico cast magnet with good magnetic energy usage efficiency.The mid-range is equipped with 12RM22 which is a 12 cm cone type skoker.Collagen cone paper is used for the diaphragm, and at the same time as controlling the split resonance region, the rubber cap is used to reduce the high frequency radiation energy from the cap and cut unnecessary bands.In addition, by adopting a large cast magnet for the magnetic circuit, a magnetic flux density of 12000 gauss has been obtained and transient characteristics have been improved.An aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame, and a back cover is used to cut off the influence of a woofer with large vibration, thereby suppressing inter-modulation distortion.50RT07, which is a 5 cm cone type tweeter, is installed in the high range.This unit is designed to reduce the influence of woofer and squaker by using aluminum die-cast for the frame.For the network part, we have adopted a coil with less DC resistance and used multiple capacitors in parallel to minimize the capacitance error of the capacitor, taking into consideration the effect on the chassis.It is also equipped with a continuously variable level control for the middle and high frequencies.The unit layout of the front baffle is symmetrical with respect to the directional pattern of the left and right speakers at the listening position. The unit is mounted so that the vibration mode of the baffle does not adversely affect music playback. In particular, the frame of the woofer is covered with synthetic rubber and is mounted on the back.The enclosure is hermetically sealed. The front baffle is made of a 19 mm thick lumber core made mainly of Chinese wood, and the other parts are made of a 25 mm thick rigid particle board, giving it a solid finish.A combination of three types of sound absorbing materials with different densities is used for internal sound absorption processing to eliminate standing waves.The exterior is finished with real wood for a simple design."

name: VS-450
description:
## Description

"A 2-way speaker system incorporating technology developed for broadcasting stations.A special amplifier was attached to this speaker system, and it was used as a compact Columbia monitor speaker at broadcasting stations around the country.A 10 cm cone type woofer with symmetric support system is mounted in the low range.DENON's original collagen diaphragm is used for the cone. This is a collagen fiber fused to corn paper after a special chemical treatment applied to animal skin. By giving it an appropriate internal resistance, resonance of peaks and dips of the cone is suppressed.In addition, in order to reduce non-linear distortion at large amplitude, symmetric support system (push-pull support system) is adopted. In addition, the connection part with voice coil is considered rigid compared to the stiffness of edge at low frequency, and one that does not generate resonance at high frequency is adopted.In this way, the distortion is canceled and the linearity to the amplitude is improved because the non-linearity of a certain shape with respect to the deformation direction is unified by reversing each other.The edge is made of a special woven fabric impregnated with a polymer material, and the linearity is greatly improved.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.The enclosure is a bass reflex type with ports, and the baffle plate is an iron plate with damping material on the back side.Air-core coils are also used in the network."

description:
## Description

"Monaural power amplifier using DENON non-feedback system.In the POA-8000, a non-feedback system that does not generate dynamic strain is adopted from the beginning, which is a complete change from the system that cancels dynamic strain.In the non-feedback system, input signals are amplified in only one direction. First of all, a signal transmission and amplification system that does not generate transient response distortion is adopted. Distortion and noise generated in the amplification system are removed by a distortion removal circuit.The circuit configuration of the POA-8000 is such that the main amplification system does not have a phase compensation circuit or Ï‰ circuit, and the amplification stage can be reduced by half. Therefore, the main amplification system amplifies the signal in real time from input to output. Moreover, since it is one way without return, no transient distortion occurs, and excellent dynamic characteristics are obtained.The distortion removal circuit is equipped with a voltage type at the first stage and a power type at the last stage.This distortion removal circuit compares the input signal and output signal of the amplifier and detects all components except for the input signal as distortion of the amplifier element. Next, the distortion component extracted here is made to be opposite phase and amplified so that the distortion component on the output side and the mixing point of the main amplifier output circuit become equal. Then, the same distortion component (opposite phase) as the distortion component on the output side is added to the output side.In this circuit, in addition to distortion, dynamic variations such as amplification, frequency characteristics, operating point drift, noise, etc., all components other than the input signal are regarded as distortion and are removed.The basic circuit is composed mainly of 3-stage Darlington power stage, and all stages from the first stage to the last stage are composed of complimentary service A class push-pull circuit non-feedback amplifier.The first stage consists of a complimentary service push-pull configuration of a low-noise, high-gain FET. In this configuration, a no-feedback voltage amplification is performed by a distortion removal circuit. The output is passed through a high-ft small-signal transistor-emitter-follower circuit, reduced in impedance, and sent to the predriver stage.The pre-driver stage has a simple circuit configuration with one stage amplification by complimentary service push-pull, in this case ft130MHz, Pc1W, V.CEOFour 200 v high-voltage transistors are used in parallel to reduce the current load on each transistor and operate under optimum conditions. A high-precision metal deposition type resistor with an accuracy error of ¥1% and temperature coefficient of ¥50 ppm is used to determine the gain of this stage, ensuring highly stable characteristics.The power stage consists of a 3-stage Darlington configuration. The fast driver stage consists of a cascode emitter follower circuit with two small signal transistors with high linearity and 400 MHz ft excellent in high-frequency characteristics. The second driver consists of a parallel push-pull circuit with four transistors. The final output stage consists of a 6-parallel push-pull circuit with 12 Pc150W high-speed power transistors.For the circuit board of the power transistor section, glass epoxy board and oxygen-free copper board with copper foil thickness of 140 Ï‰ m with minimized circuit resistance are used, thereby reducing signal transmission loss caused by circuit hand-making at high power.The digital display on the front front has a muting counter function that counts down from 7 to 0 when the power is turned on, and a speaker indication function of SP1orSP2 during normal operation.In addition, it is equipped with a self-diagnosis function, which checks whether the set is operating stably, and displays errors in coded English letters (E-7 to 0) to self-diagnose error locations. The display of E-0 indicates an abnormal temperature rise, and the display of E-3 indicates an abnormal voltage at the midpoint of the main circuit. In the event of such an error or incorrect use, the output relay is instantly cut off by the detection circuit.Equipped with peak indication type output level meter.With dB and WATT (0 dB = 200W/8 �), the peak display is from -50dB to + 5 dB. When the peak level of the output exceeds the rated output even for a moment, the red LED embedded in the meter is lit for a few seconds. The peak hold function is also used.The power supply section has a large transformer with four windings on the secondary side, and supplies high voltage and high stability current to the power section (160 v) and voltage amplifier (220 v).The power supply section consists of a high-voltage, large-capacity electrolytic capacitor and an advisory plate that employs a 1.5 mm brass plate.High-density cut 15 mm thick flat glass is used for the front panel and 6 mm thick smoked glass is used for the top glass cover.The top plate is equipped with a ventilator processed by cutting extruded aluminum material treated with black alumite.The side panel, along with an escutcheon bar, is anodized in champagne gold.Uses a 60 mm diameter machined aluminum insulator."

## Description

"High-quality monaural power amplifier with UHC single push-pull circuit.UHC-MOS (Ultra High Current-MOS) is used for audio circuits for the first time.This device has an improved gm (amplification factor) compared to bipolar transistors, enabling current linearity equivalent to 35 MOS-FETs and 3 bipolar transistors, which are commonly used, with a single device.As a result, we have completed a UHC-MOS constant, we solve the problem of large junction capacitance, and by realizing high temperature stability, we take advantage of the acoustic characteristics of the UHC-MOS even under severe operating conditions.In addition, this circuit achieves a simple and straight configuration of two voltage amplification stages and one power amplification stage without burdening the voltage amplification stage.Stable operation is realized by the UHC single push-pull circuit.In addition, by eliminating the source resistor and output circuit coil, more high-purity transmission is speaker from the ground circuit that serves as the operating reference, adverse effects on the music signal are eliminated.The power supply is equipped with two large toroidal transformers, which are removes the upper case to completely eliminate internal resonance.UHC-MOS is also used in the power supply circuit to greatly reduce power loss.The current loss of the UHC-MOS is equivalent to description:
## Description

"Stereo power amplifier using DC amplifier system.All stages of the ICL are directly connected OCL circuits. The first stage consists of a cascode-connected differential amplifier, the pre-drive stage consists of a differential-amplifier with emitter-follower input and naked gain increasing circuit, and the last stage consists of a Darlington-connected pure complimentary service push-pull.A bipolar power transistor with good switching characteristics of Pc = 100W class is adopted for the output stage to obtain a sufficient output.The power supply is constructed by 2 monaural construction using 2 power transformer system with independent left and right channels.The final stage power supply circuit contains a strong transformer for each of the left and right channels and a large-capacity power supply smoothing capacitor of 44,000 Ï‰ F (88,000 Ï‰ F in total for the left and right channels) to provide sufficient margin for large amplitude input and to prevent crosstalk between channels.A relatively large ripple current and a return current from the speaker flow through the return conductor from the 44,000 Ï‰ F smoothing capacitor to the power transformer. It is connected to the first stage or control amplifier of the left and right channels that handle a small signal voltage. This deteriorates S/N and causes crosstalk.In the POA-1003, this part is equipped with a Dual Bussler In (Dual Busline) with symmetrical left and right channels using a copper plate of 1 mm thickness to eliminate harmful effects.Various measures are taken to suppress DC drift, which is a problem in DC amplifiers.In the first stage differential circuit, TR1/2 is thermally coupled, and at the same time, the drain-source voltage is fixed by cascode connection (TR3/4) to reduce the gate current. In addition, to minimize the drift of the constant current circuit, a pattern layout method is adopted in which TR5 and the diode of its base circuit are thermally coupled.In the pre-driver stage, the bipolar transistor TR8/9 of differential amplification is thermally coupled, and a high-precision resistor is used to minimize the effect on the first stage.As a result of these considerations, the drift temperature coefficient is kept as low as 1.6 mV / Ï‰ and stable output is achieved.The power stage, pre-drive stage and final stage transistors are supplied with independent power supplies. In particular, the first stage is equipped with a stabilized power supply circuit with low internal impedance. This ensures that even slight voltage fluctuations in the final stage do not affect the first stage and prevents dynamic crosstalk.As a typical use of DC amplifier, the subsonic filter is designed to automatically turn on with a high-performance reed relay in case an abnormal DC voltage is applied to the input.In the POA 1003, the output impedance is reduced to 1/4 of the conventional one by parallel use of relay and switch contacts and direct soldering of wiring.Equipped with a logarithmic compression type peak meter.Two types of peak levels, dB and WATT, can be read.It is equipped with a protection circuit. When the power is turned on, the protection lamp turns on for approximately 10 seconds and no sound is emitted until the amplifier is in the normal state. This prevents the speaker from making a pop noise when the power is turned on.When a DC voltage is generated at the output terminal, the relay that protects the speakers operates and the protection lamp lights up.

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A stereo power amplifier with dual super no-feedback amplifier.DENON's original dual super non-feedback amplifier is used for the circuit method, and the essence of amplifier technology such as complete DC configuration and non-switching method is put into it.The dual super no-feedback circuit is designed to eliminate static distortion and inherent noise caused by nonlinear characteristics of amplification elements such as power transistors.The structure consists of three servo amplifiers : a distortion servo circuit in which the N-channel and P-channel transistors in the power stage cancel each other's distortion, and a distortion servo circuit in which the total distortion appearing in the output stage of the speaker is eliminated. The main signal is transmitted to the speaker terminal without feedback, and because there is no NFB circuit, it is not affected by the back electromotive force from the speaker, and there is no increase in distortion when the speaker is connected.F for pre-driver stageTIt uses a 150 MHz high-speed transistor and a direct DC servo circuit with a fully capacitorless signal path (fully DC configuration) for higher slew rate.The output stage adopts a 4-parallel push-pull configuration using a high-capacity high-speed power transistor of Pc130W.In addition, DENON's original bias circuit is used to eliminate switching distortion and reduce crossover distortion.The voltage amplification stage employs circuits and devices designed for high speed and wide dynamic range. In addition to three stage differential amplification using low-noise and low-feedback capacitance FET at the first stage, a Pc25W large-capacity transistor is installed at the final stage.In addition, the Unity Current Interface (UCI) circuit is adopted to emphasize the interface characteristics of the amplifier stage and power stage. This circuit is a system in which the load of the voltage amplifier stage is always constant regardless of the operation of the power stage. By driving the power stage only with voltage, higher speed and lower distortion are realized.The power supply employs a unique pure dynamic power supply system to effectively reduce dynamic IM distortion (intermodulation distortion) caused by interference between input signal and ripple current generated in the power supply.It is also equipped with a 800 VA class large toroidal transformer and 8 10,000 Ï‰ F large-capacity block capacitors, and combined with a high-output power transistor to realize a drive that does not fluctuate even when the speaker impedance drops to 2 � instantaneously. In addition, the secondary winding and subsequent parts of the power transformer are made into a complete monaural configuration. After the left and right parts are taken out separately, they pass through independent large-capacity smoothing circuits and rectifier circuits, and are supplied to the predriver stage and power stage. This improves static and dynamic crosstalk characteristics.The internal layout is twin monaural construction. The left and right channels are perfectly symmetrical with the power transformer at the center. The pre-driver / power stage, block capacitors, rectifier circuit, volume and input / output terminals are symmetrically laid out.This eliminates the mutual interference between the small-signal line and the large-current line and between the left and right channels, as well as the non-uniform characteristics.Equipped with two input terminals.In normal mode, it is input to the voltage amplifier stage via the volume. In direct mode, it jumps to the volume and is directly connected.A bar line multi-display is adopted in the center of the front panel. When the power is turned on, it blinks for a few seconds until normal operation is achieved and then falls. In addition, when an error occurs in the set, one of the four divided bars blinks to indicate the abnormal operation of overload detection, L/R DC detection and temperature detection circuit.In addition, the newly developed overload protector is built-in, and abnormality is instantly detected.Uses a speaker terminal that can be connected up to 6 mm core diameter.Uses 37 ¥0.26 mm x power cords with polarity display."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier equipped with DENON class A, which was created by thoroughly investigating class A operation.Equipped with DENON Class A by DENON's unique real bias circuit, it realizes high output while operating as A class amplifier.The output transistor is a newly developed high-speed power transistor (f) with particularly excellent high-frequency characteristics.T: 100 MHz, Pc : 150W). This transistor can be operated at high power.FEIt has good linearity and can maintain the rated output with low distortion even at 100 Hz.This high-speed power transistor has five parallel push-pull connections per channel, dramatically improving linearity and achieving low-distortion characteristics over a wide bandwidth.A real bias circuit has been adopted to solve the problems of low efficiency, heat generation and large size which were the defects of A class amplifier.Because this circuit performs class A linear amplification using the linear region of the amplification characteristics of the transistor without distortion of the signal waveform, it is controlled so that a DC bias current equal to the peak value of the signal current flowing in the transistor is supplied. This allows a stable and appropriate DC bias current to be supplied according to the magnitude of the signal waveform from a small signal to a large signal, saving power consumption and reducing heat generation. In addition, since the bias current is stably controlled by the control function regardless of the temperature condition of the output transistor, the operating state of the best condition is always maintained.In addition, the bias current is controlled to rise earlier than the signal current. In order to prevent the delay cutoff of the rise of the bias at this time, a small fixed bias current is supplied even when there is no signal, so that the bias rises one step ahead of the rise of the signal. Thus, even when a high-frequency musical tone signal with a fast rise comes, the bias rises earlier and increases, so that the operation is controlled to ensure class A operation.In addition, the fixed bias current effectively acts on the non-linear characteristics of the transistor in the small current region, and the output transistor is controlled so that it does not enter this region.This real-bias circuit realizes an efficiency of approximately 1/5 power consumption compared with conventional systems.The driver circuitTA small-signal transistor (f) having a high linearity characteristic is provided.T(400 MHz, Pc : 400 mW) are connected in parallel for each channel.F of the putter transistorTThe cascode connection of this transistor, which has four times the wide-band transmission characteristic of the transistor, further improves the high-band linearity, prevents the influence of the Cob (collector-base junction capacitance) of power transistors, etc., and prevents the degradation of the high-band characteristic by driving the output stage with a wide-band and low impedance.Power is supplied from a power supply circuit independent of the final output stage to prevent mutual interference.The pre-driver stage is balanced by a twin complimentary service differential circuit and the power stage is push-pull driven by a cascode pre-driver.The transistor used is the same f as the driver stage.TA high-speed transistor of 400 MHz is adopted, and a drive circuit capable of power drive is constructed for wide-band and low-impedance amplification.In addition, in order to maintain the stability of the operating point of differential circuits such as pre-drivers, an operation stabilizer circuit is installed to suppress the effect of temperature drift.The first stage employs a low-noise FET differential amplifier and a direct DC servo system that operates in parallel.This is the same configuration as the control amplifier PRA-2000. It is not only a servo to eliminate unnecessary coloring by removing the coupling capacitor of the input part and to obtain stability in the ultra-low range by simply shutting out DC mid-point drift. Since no servo amplifier is added to the feedback system, the noise level does not increase. By connecting differential amplifiers in parallel and DC servo to each amplifier, the noise is reduced by 3 dB and the distortion rate is improved to 1/2.The power supply section uses a separate power transformer system for the output stage and others.The power supply for the output stage consists of a large toroidal transformer with separate left and right windings and a 100,000 Ï‰ F large-capacity capacitor with low impedance up to the high frequency range. This transformer has a capacity (1000 VA) approximately twice that of a 200W + 200W B-class amplifier power supply transformer. This transformer is floated in a non-magnetic 2 mm thick aluminum chassis to prevent magnetic distortion.From the first stage to the drive stage, an EI-type power transformer is installed separately to avoid the effect of severe load fluctuation of the output stage. A constant voltage stabilizing circuit is provided to stabilize the power supply and reduce impedance.To prevent an extremely large inrush current (inrush current) when the power switch is turned on from shortening the life of the power switch or affecting other electrical appliances, we have installed an inrush prevention circuit in the power supply part to prevent troubles.Equipped with a large power meter that can directly read the left and right output levels in dB and W.The speakers and transistors are protected by a high-speed protection circuit that also serves as a muting circuit to prevent pop noise that occurs when the power switch is turned ON / OFF.When an error occurs, the protection indicator LED in the front glass flashes.The internal layout of the amplifier is symmetrical, and the power supply part is located away from the first stage circuit as far as possible in terms of position and electrical. The construction gives priority to characteristics.The the meter section of the front panel, thick flat glass is used for the overlay effect and mirror effect. When the power is turned on, the DENON mark is displayed for five to six seconds and then a large peak meter is illuminated.Mirror finish is applied to the side plate."

description:
## Description

"FM/AM tuner pursuing the theme of quality and usability.It is based on a digital synthesizer method that allows easy channel selection and accurate tuning accuracy, and is equipped with a random 16-station preset function to sufficiently cover areas with a large number of receiving stations.The memory is equipped with a memory backup function that keeps the contents of the memory for about one month after power is turned off without using batteries.The memory mechanism employs a ""4-way tuning mechanism"" that fully applies the features of the digital system to improve usability and practicability.One touch random preset tuning allows you to directly call up the desired station from among the 16 stored stations without switching between FM and AM.Auto tuning automatically finds and tunes radio waves using autoscan.Manual scanning is also available.When the power is turned on, the station is automatically selected to the last station that received the signal.In order to receive FM radio waves with high precision, we have adopted a quartz lock synthesizer system that synchronizes with the precision of the crystal oscillation according to the frequency arrangement of the broadcasting station.The comparison frequency of the PLL is set to 25 Hz, which is outside of the audible band, and the SN ratio is improved by eliminating beat and noise in the audio band by adopting a static control method that eliminates noise from the frequency display circuit, etc. This realizes high basic performance.For the front end part, the analog type uses a varactor diode equivalent to 3 circuits, and J-FET is used for the input part.The IF stage employs a ceramic filter with constant amplitude and constant delay characteristics.The AM section employs a 2-stage 3-terminal high-selectivity ceramic filter and a 1-stage coil-type filter that eliminates 9 khz beat interference, and a low-impedance loop antenna that is resistant to electric-field noise from fluorescent lamps."

## Description
