description:
## Description

"FM stereo tuner with TU 500 and TU 355 technology.The dial scale is 200 kHz equally spaced (3.4 mm) to express the usability and the accuracy of the tuner.In addition, the dial mechanism uses a flywheel with a large moment of inertia, a high-precision stainless steel shaft, and alloy bearings to maintain smooth running.The signal meter circuit employs a multi-stage amplification stage and detection system. This makes it possible to swing the signal meter in proportion to the strength of the input radio wave from the strong electric field to the weak electric field. The strength of the input radio wave at the time of broadcast reception can be measured, and the state of the radio wave can be monitored as with the multi-path terminal.It is also equipped with a tuning meter that provides the best tuning with the least distortion.A boardless package type is adopted for the front end part to improve basic performance such as sensitivity, S/N, stability, and temperature characteristics.It features a high-precision frequency linear 5-row varicon, low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET, and a triple-tune circuit with flat phase characteristics and excellent selection characteristics.The local oscillation circuit employs a clap-type oscillation circuit that is resistant to voltage and temperature fluctuations. In addition, the oscillation frequency fluctuation is minimized by using a temperature compensation capacitor and an oscillation coil that is resistant to temperature and humidity, thereby eliminating the need for an AFC circuit.The IF section consists of two circuits. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"An FM stereo tuner that uses a new method developed by DENON acoustic researchers in pursuit of sound quality in the FM detection and stereo demodulation sections.A drum type long scale dial is used for tuning.A low-noise dual-gate MOS FET is used in the high-frequency amplification stage of the front-end section to obtain high S/N and interference rejection capability.In order to achieve both the transmission characteristics for improving sound quality and the characteristics for eliminating interfering signals from the outside, the IF amplifier switches between wide-band and narrow-band characteristics. In addition, a sub amplifier system for the control system is provided separately.In wide-band operation, the sound quality is improved by using a linear phase four element ceramic filter. In narrow-band operation, the number of filter elements is increased to further eliminate interfering signals, and selectivity is improved.In order to improve linearity, the FM detector has wider characteristics than the conventional wide-band ratio detector. Moreover, by matching the impedance between the detector stage and the final stage in the IF section, the amplitude and phase characteristics are flattened and low distortion is achieved.We have also improved the S/N ratio by more than 10 dB compared with conventional ratio detectors by using carefully selected silicon diodes as diodes, which are a major factor in determining the S/N ratio of the detector circuit, and by paying attention to resistors and transistors that generate noise in circuits used around the detector circuit. In addition, fixed bias is applied to the diode to compensate for the rise characteristics of the silicon diode, resulting in low distortion.The MPX section uses a newly developed IC with superior distortion, separation, and S/N. In addition, the MPX beat elimination method using a unique PLL is employed to improve sound quality.This system focuses on the problem that interference signals are generated near the pilot signal in the FM detector or other circuits when there is a mismatch between the connection between the antenna and the tuner, or when reflected waves (multi-path radio waves) mixed with the desired radio waves reach the tuner. This system extracts only the components that shake the pilot signal at the output of the phase comparator in the PLL, and cancels the shake with the inverted signal. This system greatly reduces the shake caused by interference signals very close to the pilot signal.In addition, the newly developed IC incorporates a pilot canceler to reduce unwanted tone components and a 100% NFB circuit to improve distortion, thereby improving various characteristics.Equipped with an oscillator for recording level check.The level meter can be used to measure the power amplifier output level and multi-path.You can measure multipath by connecting an oscilloscope or pre-main amplifier to the multipath terminal.The high blend switch improves the S/N ratio when receiving stereo signals."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This is a microcomputer operated full auto player that has introduced DENON technology in various places.A direct drive system is adopted for the turntable part.The drive motor is equipped with a newly developed linear drive MF (Magne-Float) motor. It uses the attractive force between the rotor magnet and the stator yoke to reduce the load applied to the pivot by the weight of the turntable and rotor. This structure is effective in reducing uneven rotation, prevents wear of the pivot, and maintains smooth rotation performance.The servo circuit employs a bi-directional servo DENON quartz system that combines a high-precision magnetic recording detection system and a quartz lock system. The high-precision magnetic recording detection system uses a magnetic head to detect 1,000 pulse signals recorded at an accurate pitch inside the rim, which is almost the outermost peripheral position of the turntable, and controls them while comparing them with a reference voltage. It has high detection accuracy, high-speed response, and speed detection at the outer circumference where wow flutter appears most often.In addition, both forward and reverse servos provide a severe response to slight increases and decreases in rotational speed, improving static dynamic load characteristics.The tone arm uses a straight-type arm with a lighter weight.This is to bring out the performance of the high-compliance cartridge. Even when the attached cartridge or other high-performance high-compliance type is used, the low-band cutoff frequency is set to around 12 Hz, so that the ultra-low-band noise caused by the warping of the record can be eliminated.The DP-31F is equipped with a damper structure to reduce the resonance of the arm itself, and adopts a newly developed tone arm float system to actively block the vibration of the arm.In this system, four spring plates are attached to the cabinet, and an arm is attached to this plate. The vibration modes of the cabinet, plate and arm base are different, and since the plate operates only in the vertical direction, the arm floats from the cabinet, effectively suppressing howling, etc.The cartridge is equipped with DL-60, a high compliance light weight MM cartridge.In pursuit of high musical expressive power, this cartridge uses a precise vibration system to realize the ability of flat reproduction up to 30 kHz or higher with a needle pressure of 1.8g. It also uses an elliptical needle to reduce tracing distortion in the high-frequency range.The tone arm drive system of the full-auto mechanism uses a unique contactless system to eliminate factors that cause sound quality degradation and to realize excellent operability.The DP-31F has a configuration in which the arm is operated by two precision dedicated angular control motors for horizontal operation and lifter operation. The operation of the arm is commanded by the microcomputer. Therefore, during both horizontal operation and lifter operation of the arm, the arm is in a free state as in manual machines, and the arm is not mechanically restrained even when the auto mechanism is in operation. Therefore, good arm sensitivity and usability are achieved.In addition, with the adoption of an electronic servo lifter, the arm moves up and down at a constant speed. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This is a player system that pursues ease of use by adopting a new mechanism for the direct drive player.The newly developed electronically controlled servo tone arm is used for the tone arm.By turning the position selector (location knob) on the front panel, the dedicated MC-type angular control motor set at the base of the arm is servocontrol and the arm can be moved smoothly.Moreover, since the arm is contact-free, there is no loss of sensitivity of the arm, and even if the arm is touched while moving, there is no effect.The position selector uses a 2-point contact type touch sensor switch.When you touch the knob for cue, the arm leaves the rest and moves onto the record board. When you turn the knob to position the needle tip of the cartridge, release the hand. If the lifter is pushed, the arm goes down and the turntable rotates to start playing.If you want to listen to it again during the performance, touch the knob again. The arm automatically rises and returns to the position indicated by the position selector again to start the performance.If the repeat switch is set to ON, it automatically returns from the end of the record to the beginning and starts playing without returning to the arm rest.The horizontal movement of the auto arm is performed while maintaining the optimum speed with the servocontrol. Up is performed quickly with the dedicated motor and down is performed slowly with the oil brake.The newly developed MC-type angular control motor for driving the arm consists of a fixed magnet and a movable coil directly connected to the rotating shaft of the arm. The rotating shaft is driven by the current flowing in the coil, and it is contact-free. Therefore, it does not give unnecessary load to the arm and is not affected by external magnetic field.The rotation angle of the arm is detected by the combination of the LED, CDs, and a polarizing plate placed between them. One polarizing plate is attached to the rotation axis of the arm, and the other two polarizing plates are fixed with a polarization angle of 90 degrees each. When the arm moves from the outer circumference to the inner circumference of the record, the polarizing plate rotates, the amount of light incident on the CDs changes, and the position of the arm becomes the rotation angle signal.The position selector emits a signal corresponding to an arbitrary position on the record board, and the arm moves until this signal matches the arm rotation angle signal.The speed at which the arm moves is servocontrol to a constant speed. The rotation angle detection signal of the arm is proportional to the change in the rotation angle, but the rate of change is also detected by the servo circuit and is always controlled to a constant speed.Anti-skating controls the torque of the MC type angular control motor and cancels the inside force.At the innermost circumference of the record, the arm's rapid movement is simultaneously detected by the arm position and lead-out (derived groove), and the dedicated motor for the arm lifter operates.A unique magnetic recording detection rotational speed servo system has been adopted for the turntable drive unit, taking advantage of the quartz lock system.The magnetic recording detection type speed servo detects 1,000 pulses magnetically recorded at an extremely accurate pitch inside the rim of the turntable. The detection accuracy is high and the response is fast. It is highly effective against warping and disturbance of records.The newly developed high-cost performance AC servo motor is used as the drive motor.Newly developed turntable seat is adopted.This turntable sheet was developed based on vibration analysis by laser holographic interference."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"Full auto player with almost the same configuration as DP-52F and MM type cartridge installedAdopts a full auto mechanism.The tone arm is driven by a non-contact structure that does not affect the tone arm sensitivity or rotation system, and smooth operation is achieved by microprocessor commands.In addition, it is designed for safety. When there is no record on the turntable, the tone arm does not operate, so there is no trouble of needle tip.In addition, by the adoption of electronic servo lifter, it is not affected by temperature and needle pressure, etc., and the tone arm shows up and down movement at a constant speed, and the impact between the needle tip and the record is minimized.With the full auto function, when you press the Start button, the sensor automatically detects the size and rotation speed of the record (33 1/3 rotation for 30 cm, 45 rotation for 17 cm) and the performance starts. In the case of a record such as a 45 rotation disc for 30 cm records, you can respond by pressing the Start button and then pressing the specified rotation speed button.The tone arm is equipped with a dynamic servo tracer light mass straight arm.As a straight arm with a light mass, the fo is set at around 10 Hz to avoid the influence of the modulation noise in the ultra-low band caused by the warping of records, etc., and further to be out of the audible band.In addition, the dynamic servo tracer controls the Q to an ideal state. This is a method of controlling the current flowing in the drive coil by detecting the minute movement (horizontal and vertical) of the tone arm with the detection coil. This suppresses the force of the arm moving in the direction opposite to the needle vibration at the fo point, greatly improving the tracing capability.The appropriate needle pressure is obtained by operating the vertical axis drive coil of the dynamic servo tracer mechanism.Equipped with an electronic anti-skating mechanism, it has a non-contact structure that cancels the inside force by controlling the current flowing in the arm's horizontal drive coil, so you can always get an appropriate amount of cancellation without sensitivity loss due to mechanical friction.The motor is equipped with an AC servo motor, which is characterized by low electrical noise and no cocking.It uses a DENON quartz speed servo mechanism that combines a high-accuracy magnetic recording detection system with a quartz lock.The magnetic recording detection method employs a speed detection method at approximately the outer circumference of the turntable, which is best detected by a wow / flutter. The magnetic head detects 1000 pulse signals recorded magnetically at an accurate pitch inside the rim of the outer circumference of the turntable. This detection method detects 555.5 Hz at 33 1/3 rotation, which is higher than that of the general FG method. Therefore, it realizes a stable servo system with excellent detection accuracy and response and high gain.The magnetic recording head uses a 2-in-1 type servo mechanism that is effective in both directions. This servo mechanism not only servos the rotational speed lag, but also provides quick response at the start-up time. It is also effective at the start-up and drop-down times when the rotational speed is changed.An electronic brake is adopted, and the brake operation starts immediately after the needle tip is separated from the record surface after the record performance is finished, and the brake operation is released after the turntable stops, realizing a mechanism without reverse rotation.The cabinet uses a slim design wood cabinet with a wood-grain finish.Self-illuminated feather touch switches are used.It uses a quick repeat method so that the tone arm does not return to the arm rest during repeated performance, but returns directly to the starting point of the performance of the record.The cartridge is equipped with MM type cartridge DL-60 as standard.The elliptical needle reduces tracing distortion in the high frequency range.It adopts a special head shell replacement system and comes with a carbon head shell that is lightweight and has high resonance resistance.In order to improve adhesion to the phonograph record and vibration damping effect, we have adopted a turntable sheet that has been thoroughly analyzed in terms of both material and shape.It uses an insulator with high vibration isolation effect and adjustable height.Uses a low-capacity output cord.An integrally molded dust cover has been adopted."

This ultra-low frequency noise can be prevented by setting the low-frequency resonance frequency (fo : about 10 Hz) by using a light-mass arm. However, when a high-compliance cartridge is used, the cartridge body itself swings around the low-frequency resonance frequency stimulated by the warping and eccentricity of a record, and the output becomes large.It is equipped with an electronic Q-dump mechanism to eliminate the increase in crosstalk and ultra-low frequency noise caused by this phenomenon, and the effects of record warping and eccentricity are eliminated by the Q-dump mechanism and light-mass arm.Newly developed light weight straight arm is used for the arm.This arm uses a light mass arm pipe with a diameter of approximately 1.3 times the diameter with improved precision of the fulcrum, drawing out the performance of a light needle pressure and high compliance cartridge.The lead wires of the arm pipe are made of Litz wire, which is composed of 11 twisted oxygen-free copper wires. name: DENON
description:
## Description

"An armless record player developed by integrating all of DENON's player technology.The drive motor employs a 10 kg out Rocester 3-phase AC servo motor with a torque of 10kg-cm that is used for cutting machines as well as for broadcasting station players. This powerful motor has a weight of 6.5 kg and a moment of inertia of 1,260kg-cm.2To 33 1/3 revolutions in only 0.4 seconds from the start.A high S / N ratio has been achieved by the adoption of an AC3-phase drive system that eliminates the third harmonic of the rotating magnetic field, which causes vibration and reversing torque, and by the adoption of a winding system that ensures uniform magnetic flux between the rotor and stator, even if there is a gap between the rotor and stator, and by the consistent vibration resistant structure including the frame.The shaft is made of special stainless steel with a diameter of 14 mm. After heat treatment and high-precision polishing, it is wrapped.A special alloy is used for the radial bearing, and smooth rotation is obtained by lapping, and high durability is obtained by using a mirror-finished sapphire bearing for the thrust bearing that supports the entire rotating system.It is equipped with a safety mechanism to prevent troubles caused by unexpected external forces. It operates when a load of approximately 50 kg or more is applied to the turntable to prevent damage to sapphire bearings, etc.For the turntable, we have further developed the double-structured turntable used in the DP-80 and so on.Structurally, the upper and lower turntables are connected by a spring and a fluid damper, and the lower part is fixed to the motor rotor, so that the upper part where records are placed is vibrationally isolated from the motor and frame, and a high-cut filter is formed by the mass of the upper turntables and the compliance of the spring.In addition, the adverse effect of acoustic feedback caused by sound pressure transmitted directly from the speaker to the record and upper turntable is solved by the difference in vibration mode due to the difference in mass between the two turntables, the fluid damper between the two turntables, and the turntable seat with high vibration absorption effect.These measures eliminate harmful vibrations and eliminate sound coloring, as well as problems such as poor crosstalk caused by affecting the opposite channel in the heavy low-frequency portion of a record, resulting in an unclear sound image.The upper and lower turntables are integrated in the direction of rotation.The servo mechanism uses a double PLL servo system combining DENON quartz and PLL synthesizer IC.DENON quartz has developed and adopted DENON's original magnetic recording detection method that applies 1000 pulse signals. Two pulse detection heads are attached at two opposing positions. This has the effect of mutually canceling the very slight eccentricity of the magnetic pulse recording surface, making it possible to pick up a highly accurate detection signal. By comparing the phases of the obtained signal with the phases of the signal generated by the reference oscillator (crystal), a powerful two way servomechanism that can control the rotational speed more severely is realized. In addition, it is an advanced method that detects the speed at the periphery of the turntable where the wow flutter phenomenon can be detected most prominently.In the double PLL servo system, the oscillation frequency is accurately changed while maintaining the accuracy of the quartz oscillator. This frequency is used as the reference frequency for the phase comparator circuit of the motor servo system, and the pitch can be controlled in a quartz-locked state.The pitch control circuit can be combined with a digital display to set an accurate pitch from high9.9% to low9.9% with an accuracy of 0.1% pitch (half tone = 5.9%) at each specified rotation speed.This powerful servomechanism has achieved load resistance of 1.5 kg in terms of needle pressure.The frame is made of thick cast aluminum with a total weight of 13 kg and is less susceptible to the effects of floors and sound pressure.In addition, a servo circuit, various control circuits, transformers, etc. are mounted floating, and at the same time, vibration and noise are taken into consideration.A solid insulator composed of a spring and a fluid damper is used for the insulator.The low-frequency cutoff frequency is set to 3.5 kg, and vibration transmitted from the floor to the frame body is prevented. Natural vibration caused by the insulator and frame noise are also prevented by the fluid damper.The arm board adopts an arm board exchange system that enables the mounting of internal and external long type tone arms. The arm board is made of aluminum casting, and by floating the board itself, a strong anti-vibration structure is realized.The floating arm board is structurally similar to a turntable. Vibration from the frame is eliminated by a spring and a fluid damper, and disturbance energy due to acoustic feedback and vibration of the arm board are absorbed and attenuated.The replacement armboard was sold separately and made to order."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A record player equipped with a dynamic servo tracer as a tone arm in the mechanism of the DP-100.The DP-100M has a dynamic servo tracer in its tone arm.The low resonance frequency (fo) set by the cartridge compliance and the effective mass of the tone arm should ideally be around 10 Hz in order to avoid the effects of record warping and eccentricity. In DENON, the negative effects such as modulation distortion were reduced by making the single tone arm and the tone arm of the player system lighter. However, if the fo peak (Q) remains high, the cantilever of the arm and cartridge vibrates more than expected in records with warpage, etc., and the needle pressure changes occur and the tracing capability deteriorates, causing intermodulation distortion.In the dynamic servo tracer, the Q of fo is electronically damped to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to increase of intermodulation distortion caused by low-frequency resonance and deterioration of crosstalk.First, the vibration of the tone arm is detected as an electric signal by two detection coils (vertical and horizontal). This signal is passed through a high-pass filter with a variable cut-off frequency volume. After passing through a gain volume, the signal is applied to a power amplification drive coil to provide a signal opposite to the vibration of the tone arm, and the vibration of the arm is controlled.This effectively dampens the low-frequency resonance compared to the non-damped fo characteristic, approaching the ideal low-frequency reproduction with no peaks.Since the low resonance frequency and peak vary depending on the type of cartridge, it is equipped with a variable filter and can be used with various cartridges by adjusting the gain volume.The tone arm is equipped with a long type light weight, high rigidity straight arm.The straight pipe part is heat-cured with a special light alloy similar to the cantilever of the cartridge to achieve weight reduction and sufficient strength.The head shell adopts a three layer laminate structure, and the division vibration of the head shell part is damped by combining a viscoelastic material with moderate viscous and large internal loss between two layers of hard light alloy.The arm pipe is replaceable, and by replacing it with a universal S-shaped arm pipe, it is possible to replace cartridges attached to general head shells.Equipped with an anti-skating mechanism.The DP-100M uses the fo damping mechanism to control the current flowing in the horizontal damping control coil to obtain a canceling effect corresponding to the needle pressure without contact in order to optimally cancel the inside force which changes from the outer circumference to the inner circumference of the record every moment.The arm lifter of the tone arm is driven by a special angular control motor. The speed at the time of descent is variable type, and the signal detected by the speed detection coil for the lifter is amplified and compared with the reference voltage proportional to the set speed to servo the effective speed. In addition, the width of the needle pressure up to approximately 20g is covered for the same set speed.The lifter can be operated with the lifter Up/Dow switch. It is also linked with the phono motor Start/Stop switch so that the motor starts to lift down and stops to lift up.The height adjustment mechanism of the tone arm adopts a precision helicoid type arm elevation mechanism similar to the rotation mechanism of the lens image of the camera, and it can be smoothly adjusted only by the back and forth operation of the lever.The adjustment range is as wide as 8 mm, and most of the cartridges for purpura can be used while keeping them horizontal.The drive motor employs a 10 kg out Rocester 3-phase AC servo motor with a torque of 10kg-cm that is used for cutting machines as well as for broadcasting station players. This powerful motor has a weight of 6.5 kg and a moment of inertia of 1,260kg-cm.2To 33 1/3 revolutions in only 0.4 seconds from the start.A high S / N ratio has been achieved by the adoption of an AC3-phase drive system that eliminates the third harmonic of the rotating magnetic field, which causes vibration and reversing torque, and by the adoption of a winding system that ensures uniform magnetic flux between the rotor and stator, even if there is a gap between the rotor and stator, and by the consistent vibration resistant structure including the frame.The shaft is made of special stainless steel with a diameter of 14 mm. After heat treatment and high-precision polishing, it is wrapped.A special alloy is used for the radial bearing, and smooth rotation is obtained by lapping, and high durability is obtained by using a mirror-finished sapphire bearing for the thrust bearing that supports the entire rotating system.It is equipped with a safety mechanism to prevent troubles caused by unexpected external forces. It operates when a load of approximately 50 kg or more is applied to the turntable to prevent damage to sapphire bearings, etc.For the turntable, we have further developed the double-structured turntable used in the DP-80 and so on.Structurally, the upper and lower turntables are connected by a spring and a fluid damper, and the lower part is fixed to the motor rotor, so that the upper part where records are placed is vibrationally isolated from the motor and frame, and a high-cut filter is formed by the mass of the upper turntables and the compliance of the spring.In addition, the adverse effect of acoustic feedback caused by sound pressure transmitted directly from the speaker to the record and upper turntable is solved by the difference in vibration mode due to the difference in mass between the two turntables, the fluid damper between the two turntables, and the turntable seat with high vibration absorption effect.These measures eliminate harmful vibrations and eliminate sound coloring, as well as problems such as poor crosstalk caused by affecting the opposite channel in the heavy low-frequency portion of a record, resulting in an unclear sound image.The upper and lower turntables are integrated in the direction of rotation.The servo mechanism uses a double PLL servo system combining DENON quartz and PLL synthesizer IC.DENON quartz has developed and adopted DENON's original magnetic recording detection method that applies 1000 pulse signals. Two pulse detection heads are attached at two opposing positions. This has the effect of mutually canceling the very slight eccentricity of the magnetic pulse recording surface, making it possible to pick up a highly accurate detection signal. By comparing the phases of the obtained signal with the phases of the signal generated by the reference oscillator (crystal), a powerful two way servomechanism that can control the rotational speed more severely is realized. In addition, it is an advanced method that detects the speed at the periphery of the turntable where the wow flutter phenomenon can be detected most prominently.In the double PLL servo system, the oscillation frequency is accurately changed while maintaining the accuracy of the quartz oscillator. This frequency is used as the reference frequency for the phase comparator circuit of the motor servo system, and the pitch can be controlled in a quartz-locked state.The pitch control circuit can be combined with a digital display to set an accurate pitch from high9.9% to low9.9% with an accuracy of 0.1% pitch (half tone = 5.9%) at each specified rotation speed.This powerful servomechanism has achieved load resistance of 1.5 kg in terms of needle pressure.The frame is made of thick cast aluminum with a total weight of 13 kg and is less susceptible to the effects of floors and sound pressure.In addition, a servo circuit, various control circuits, transformers, etc. are mounted floating, and at the same time, vibration and noise are taken into consideration.A solid insulator composed of a spring and a fluid damper is used for the insulator.The low-frequency cutoff frequency is set to 3.5 kg, and vibration transmitted from the floor to the frame body is prevented. Natural vibration caused by the insulator and frame noise are also prevented by the fluid damper.The arm board adopts an arm board exchange system that enables the mounting of internal and external long type tone arms. The arm board is made of aluminum casting, and by floating the board itself, a strong anti-vibration structure is realized.The floating arm board is structurally similar to a turntable. Vibration from the frame is eliminated by a spring and a fluid damper, and disturbance energy due to acoustic feedback and vibration of the arm board are absorbed and attenuated.The replacement armboard was sold separately and made to order."

This vibration is caused by improper meshing between the cassette hub and the hub shaft of the deck. It can cause noise nigori. description:
## Description

"A cassette deck developed by inheriting the performance of DR 750.By adopting a precision machined aluminum casting frame for the mechanism part, the tape running system is stabilized.The drive mechanism adopts the direct detection speed servo 2 capstan system.In this method, the rotational speed of the capstan is directly detected by the magnetic head which detects 500 pulses magnetically recorded with high precision on the outer circumference of the flywheel of the main capstan shaft, and the drive motor is controlled so that the rotational speed of the main capstan becomes constant.In addition, a non-elastic belt that does not expand or contract is used for the belt that connects the motor and the flywheel. This design prevents resonance between the belt and the flywheel and uneven tension between the left and right capstan caused by uneven belt thickness.In addition, since the two capstan system is adopted, vibration generated in the half is cut off by both capstan, and the effect on the head surface is reduced.The head uses a 3-laminate type Sendust head that has a large saturation magnetic flux density and does not cause magnetic saturation even for large input signals during recording.In addition to the use of carefully selected low-noise transistors for the playback equalizer amplifier, we have also selected low-noise components in consideration of sound quality for the circuit components. In addition, by adopting a 3-stage direct-coupled configuration, the circuit has a high SN ratio and stable operation.The recording amplifier uses a circuit with a wide dynamic range and low distortion to improve the frequency characteristics of recording and playback.A gold-plated relay with twin contacts is used for recording and re-switching of the amplifier to prevent noise generation during switching and improve reliability and durability.Large-size complimentary service ICs are used for the line amplifier, and sufficient power level and low output impedance are obtained.Equipped with Dolby NR as a noise reduction system.An IC regulator is used for the power supply, and stability is enhanced by separating the drive system, control system, and amplifier system from the secondary winding of the transformer.Equipped with continuously variable bias and tape selector.Equipped with a recording mute mechanism.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism.Equipped with a peak level meter.Equipped with a remote control terminal and can be connected to the separately sold remote controller RC-50."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This is a cassette deck with some functions omitted from DR-F3 and DR-F2.The mechanism uses a new 3-head mechanism with improved tape running accuracy and head touch.This mechanism is equipped with a newly developed tension servo sensor to obtain good running performance. In this tension servo sensor, a sensor set between the recording / playback combination head and the erasing head constantly detects the back tension of the tape between the two heads. Minute fluctuations are amplified through the sensor arm and servo bracket, and the pressure force between the erasing head and the erasing head and the pressure post on the opposite side is controlled by the sensor arm and servo bracket. This servo system has an extremely short servo loop and applies direct servo to the tape itself. Therefore, it has an extremely high response and forms a stable tape running system that does not put excessive force on the tape. This eliminates the influence of the tape supply reel in the cassette half, the left side guide roller, and the left side first tape guide, and constantly adjusts the remaining amount of the tape and the tape tension converted by the cassette half.The basic mechanism of tape travel employs a two motor drive mechanism that completely separates the capstan drive and reel drive mechanisms. The mechanism is driven by an IC logic circuit and two plungers.A DC servo motor is exclusively used for the capstan motor. Since there is no external load between the capstan and the high-precision flywheel, rotational accuracy is further improved, and excellent characteristics, stability, reliability and durability are obtained.In addition, by using two plungers, the movement mechanisms of the pinch roller and the head are made independent. When the recording pause state is set, only the head part touches the tape, and when the recording state is set by pressing the PLAY button, only the pinch roller moves. This head plate mechanism prevents erasure during recording, does not give magnetic flux change to the tape while the head is moving, and also prevents unpleasant noise.A non-slip reel drive mechanism drive mechanism that takes advantage of the relationship between the rotational speed and torque of the reel motor, eliminating the general mechanical slip mechanism (using friction between felt and metal, etc.) that is installed between the motor and the take-up reel stand in a general cassette deck.In this mechanism, the voltage of the reel motor is reduced to about 1/5 of the speed when it is fast-forwarded or rewound, and the rotation speed is reduced to about 1/20 to transmit the rotation of the motor to the reel table. Originally, DC motors have characteristics that when the load increases, the rotational speed decreases and the torque increases, and when the load decreases, the opposite phenomenon occurs. This characteristic is used to equalize the winding tape tension and eliminate the slip reduction mechanism.This eliminates the instability of take-up due to changes in environmental conditions such as temperature and humidity, and improves the durability of the mechanism.The head section uses a 3-head system consisting of a read / write combination head and an erase head.An F-ALLOY combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head has a wide gap to maximize the MOL of each tape. The reproducing head has a narrow gap width of approximately 1/5 of the recording gap to obtain a flat frequency characteristic up to high frequencies. In addition, F-ALLOY, which has excellent characteristics of high magnetic flux density, high magnetic permeability, and high wear resistance, achieves high sensitivity and low distortion.In order to eliminate the coil winding method and core shape are carefully examined in order to eliminate the influence between both recording and playback heads. A shield mask is inserted between both heads to strictly suppress the magnetic field (cross feed) from the recording head to the reproducing head to -78dB.In addition, by adopting a special core shape, good head touch is obtained, drop-out is reduced and contour effect is suppressed.A double-gap erase head with an E-shaped core is used for the erase head.The core of this erasing head is made of a special ferrite material with high saturation magnetic flux density to enhance the erasing effect.The amplifier section uses an all-DC configuration amplifier with independent recording and playback.In this amplifier, the condenser between the head and the first stage amplifier is removed to eliminate the deterioration of sound quality in the signal transmission system. In addition, all of the microphone amplifier, recording amplifier, equalizer amplifier, playback amplifier, headphone amplifier, and meter amplifier are composed of DC amplifier units, and ¥2 power supply system is used to drive them. Together with the low-noise differential input push-pull circuit, this amplifier increases the dynamic range and prevents clipping distortion in the signal transmission system.The bias oscillation circuit adopts a push-pull configuration to improve bias waveform distortion.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a 20 to + 6 dB wide scale VU meter.It also features three LeD peak level indicators : red (+ 8 dB), yellow (+ 5 dB), and green (0 dB).Equipped with a 4-stage tape selector with a bias and equalizer linked together.It is equipped with an output level control function that can also adjust the volume of headphones.Equipped with an auto-cue review mechanism that finds out between songs of more than 4 seconds and automatically enters the play state from that position.Equipped with one touch rec-pause function.The Rec Mute and Pause buttons are grouped together.During recording, if you keep pressing the button, it becomes REC MUTE ; if you release it, it becomes PAUSE ; and if you press the PLAY button again, it becomes recording.When there is no signal, the PAUSE/MUTE LED lights up at approximately one second intervals.It uses a one touch eject mechanism, and regardless of the operation state of the mechanism, the mechanism automatically stops, releases each operation and ejects.Equipped with timer recording and playback mechanism.Remote control terminal is mounted on the front, and operation from a remote place is possible by using an optional remote control unit."

## Description

Minute fluctuations are amplified through the sensor arm and servo bracket, and the pressure force between the erasing head and the erasing head and the pressure post on the opposite side is controlled by the sensor arm and servo bracket. This servo system has an extremely short servo loop and applies direct servo to the tape itself. Therefore, it has an extremely high response and forms a stable tape running system that does not put excessive force on the tape. This eliminates the influence of the tape supply reel in the cassette half, the left side guide roller, and the left side first tape guide, and constantly adjusts the remaining amount of the tape and the tape tension converted by the cassette half.The basic mechanism of tape travel employs a two motor drive mechanism that completely separates the capstan drive and reel drive mechanisms. In addition, there are no brushes, slots, or cores that affect rotational accuracy or noise problems, and only the motor bearing is mechanically worn. This eliminates the mechanical slip mechanism (using friction between felt and metals) between the motor and the take-up reel stand, eliminating the fluctuation of the winding force due to changes in environmental conditions such as temperature and moisture, eliminating the drop-out caused by uneven winding, and the deterioration of wow flutter and phase characteristics.Equipped with the Tension Servo Sensor II, which is an improved version of the Tension Servo Sensor, a unique servo mechanism. This eliminates the influence of the structure of the cassette half, stabilizes the back tension that changes depending on the remaining amount of tape, and achieves good head touch.An M & X combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head is designed to maximize the MOL of each tape. The reproducing head is designed to have a narrow gap of approximately 1/5 of the recording gap in order to obtain a flat frequency characteristic up to the high-frequency range. In addition to minimizing the azimuth deviation of the A/B plane of the tape by precise assembly technology, the magnetic field (cross feed) from the recording head to the reproducing head is also completely suppressed.The erasing head uses a double-gap ferrite head with an E-shaped core that is compatible with the high retention force and high residual magnetic flux density of metal tapes.In the amplifier section, the condenser between the head and the first stage amplifier is eliminated, and all DC amplifiers are used up to the last stage.With particular emphasis on clipping distortion in transmission systems, the equalizer amplifier uses a low-noise differential input push-pull circuit and a ¥2 high-voltage power supply to expand the dynamic range.The bias circuit has a push-pull configuration to improve the bias waveform distortion and at the same time obtain sufficient erase current.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.In addition, by adopting the double Dolby system, it is possible to confirm the Dolby effect when monitoring simultaneous playback.Equipped with MPX filter switch to prevent malfunction of Dolby system.Feather touch control by IC circuit is adopted for the operation system of the tape running.Timing control is also considered in this circuit to prevent overstretching of the tape.It is equipped with the output level control which can adjust the volume of the headphone.Equipped with a one touch rec pause function, recording standby can be set just by pressing the REC button.The Rec Mute and Pause buttons are combined into one to improve operability.Equipped with one touch eject function, the mechanism is released and ejected just by pressing the eject button even if the mechanism is in operation state.Equipped with a timer recording / playback mechanism capable of intermittent recording.Wired Remote Controller RC-57 sold separately can be used."

Furthermore, the laminated type improves the high-frequency performance and enables recording with less distortion.The two erasing heads, one for forward and the other for reverse, have a double-gap structure to achieve a strong erasing effect even for metal tapes.In order to match the characteristics of each track of the head, the playback amplifier section uses four playback equalizer amplifiers that are specially tuned for each track. This, combined with the fixed head system, shortens the rise time until the tape is reversed and moves to constant speed, enabling quick reverse of approximately 0.16 seconds.Silence is suppressed to less than 0.4 seconds when reversing the tape.The tape reversal position is detected by an infrared tape sensor set opposite the forward erasing head. This detection position uses the back side of the area where the tape runs on the erasing head surface, so there is no malfunction even if a tape with a crease is used. The detection position optically accurately detects the boundary between the recording tape and the reader tape, ensuring reliable operation.A microcomputer control system is used to drive the loading motor. The microcomputer quickly processes signals from an infrared sensor and directions of tape movement, and drives the loading motor for mode switching.This motor performs track switching of a 4-track, 4-channel fixed head and crimping / releasing pinch rollers, thus minimizing unpleasant mechanical noise during tape reversal.Equipped with a travel direction memory, the tape travel direction is memorized even when the power is turned off.The basic mechanism of tape travel is a two motor drive system with separate capstan drive and reel drive.The capstan uses a DC servo motor whose rotational speed is less affected by temperature changes in the mechanism, and the reel uses a DC motor.Equipped with a non-slip reel drive mechanism, the tape tension on the take-up side is kept constant to prevent changes in tape running accuracy and uneven winding of the tape regardless of the amount of the tape wound.Since the L series is a reverse machine, this mechanism is installed on both left and right sides.Equipped with output level control for both headphone output and lineout.Equipped with timer standby mechanism, it is possible to record the absence and play the alarm clock by using the timer sold separately.When recording, the recording stops after one round recording, so that the recording on the opposite side is not deleted.Equipped with VU meter and 3-point peak level indicator.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with 3-step switching type Otre Tape Selector.In the automatic mode, the detection mechanism operates to detect normal, chrome and metal tape types and automatically set the bias / equalizer. ## Description

In addition, the problem of tape overrun due to time lag in the motor cam drive has been solved by computer processing. The rotary encoder detects the position of the cam and applies digital feedback servo to achieve accurate rotational position control.By reducing the slip between the capstan and pinch roller and improving the tape tension characteristics, we have achieved stable rotational accuracy and also pursued the accuracy of the capstan shaft.It is equipped with DENON's own progress tension servo sensor in order to obtain appropriate back tension.This keeps the back tension, which changes depending on the remaining amount of tape, constant, and realizes a stable touch to improve the level fluctuation and drop-out. In addition, the effect of the structure of the cassette half is eliminated.The capstan motor uses a direct-drive servo motor.This motor has a unique flat-faced design that provides strong rotational torque, eliminates uneven torque, and improves wow flutter. In addition, the brushless structure eliminates electrical noise and improves durability.The servo circuit uses the all-round integral sample-and-hold method.Non-slip reel drive system eliminates variations in winding force due to mechanical slip and changes in environmental conditions, thereby eliminating dropouts due to uneven winding, and deterioration of wow flutter and phase characteristics.Uses SF (Super Frequency) combination head for recording and reproducing head.This head combines a recording head designed to maximize the MOL of each tape with a reproducing head with improved high-frequency characteristics by using a newly developed ferrite material. In addition, Sendust is used in the guard part to greatly improve abrasion resistance.The SF head also uses oxygen-free copper wire for the coil to improve sound quality.The power supply circuit completely separates the amplifier system from the logic system to eliminate mutual interference. By combining with a separately sold timer, it is possible to record absence and play an alarm.A one touch rec-pause mechanism is adopted, and recording standby can be performed just by pressing the REC button.The FL peak meter is mounted on the display.In this FL meter, Dolby B & C, Tape Source and Tape Position are displayed centrally.It uses a Pause/Mute mechanism that combines Rec Mute and Pause to improve operability.During recording, press and hold to set Rec Mute, release to set Pause, and press the Play switch again to return to the recording mode.Equipped with a follow-up recording mechanism, you can change from a regenerating condition with the tape running to a recording state with one touch operation.Equipped with remote control terminal, Wired Remote Control RC-57 can be used."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"A cassette deck developed as the highest quality model of the M series.The mechanism uses a two capstan system, in which two sets of capstan are installed around the head, and the rotational speed of each of the two sets of capstan is slightly changed to achieve appropriate tape tension near the head and stable tape travel.In addition, both capstans and pinch rollers cut off tape vibrations caused by the movement of the hub in the cassette half and the sliding of the tape with the slip sheet before they affect the head surface, thus achieving clear sound quality with less modulation noise.The capstan drive motor uses a direct-drive motor with a flat-faced design to obtain strong rotational torque and eliminate uneven torque. In addition, since it is brushless, it generates no electrical noise and improves durability.In addition, the wow flutter has been improved by directly driving the capstan and directly servoing it in combination with the speed detection mechanism attached to the flywheel surface. This servo circuit also employs an all-round integrated sample-and-hold type FG servo, providing high gain and extremely high stability.The DR-M4 uses a quartz lock system to control the rotational speed, and the phase control circuit using an accurate and stable crystal oscillator makes the FG servo operation more reliable.A silent mechanism has been adopted for the running system.In this mechanism, a motor-cam drive is adopted without using a large mechanical noise such as a plunger. In addition, a microcomputer is placed between an optical detection counter, a unique position detection encoder, and a mechanical control motor (for cam drive), and a computer controls searching for tape points and checking the drive mode.Non-slip reel drive system has been adopted to achieve uniform winding tension.This system takes advantage of the characteristics of the relationship between the rotational speed and torque of the reel motor. It eliminates changes in the take-up force due to changes in temperature and moisture, which are problems with general mechanical slip mechanisms, and improves the drop-out, wow flutter, phase characteristics, etc., as well as the durability of the mechanism.Uses SF (Super Frequency) combination head for recording and reproducing head.Super Permalloy with high saturation magnetic flux density is used for the core of the recording head, and it is compatible with high-level recording tapes such as metal tapes. Moreover, by using Sendust for the dummy core, abrasion resistance is greatly improved.In addition, a high-density ferrite core with low high-frequency loss and excellent abrasion resistance was adopted for the reproducing head for the first time as a combination head. Moreover, by reducing the size of magnetic particles to less than 1/2 of the conventional size, fluctuation of magnetic characteristics due to sliding noise and temperature change, which cause modulation noise, is improved.The SF head is a combination of these heads. In particular, the recording gap and the playback gap, which are indispensable for maintaining high frequency and phase characteristics, are kept within 1/20 degree of parallel deviation, and wide and flat frequency characteristics are obtained. In addition, oxygen-free copper wire is used for the coil to improve sound quality.The power supply circuit completely separates the amplifier circuit from the logic circuit to eliminate mutual interference. The amplifier circuit uses an independent power supply system called an independent power supply to stabilize the circuit.A low-noise differential input push-pull DC amplifier circuit is used for both the recording amplifier and the playback amplifier. A ¥2 power supply system supplies a high-voltage power supply to further expand the dynamic range and prevent clipping distortion in the signal transmission system. In addition, the capacitor between the playback head and the first stage amplifier is removed, and a DC amplifier is used up to the last stage to improve sound quality.The bias circuit employs a highly stable transformer and push-pull configuration to improve bias waveform distortion and reduce erase noise.A wide-range peak meter using a fluorescent bar graph method is used for the display.In the FL meter, Dolby B & C, monitor, tape position, etc. are displayed centrally. In addition, the peak meter is equipped with a peak hold function which Oatley set every 1.5 seconds.A one touch rec-pause mechanism is adopted, and recording standby can be performed just by pressing the REC button.Uses Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction systems.The DR-M4 has a double-Dolby configuration so that Dolby playback is possible even during simultaneous recording and monitoring.Built-in MPX filter allows cutting of 19 kHz pilot signal of FM source.A computer counter is used, and by switching the switch, not only the normal 4-digit electronic counter but also the driving time can be displayed in minutes and seconds.Equipped with a computer tuning function.This function automatically finds the best position for a tape among 100,000 adjustments, adjusts the sensitivity for any tape, and sets the frequency response to be flat.It is equipped with a computer search function that can find the beginning of 20 songs before and after.This function operates by detecting the unrecorded portion of 3 to 4 seconds or more between songs.Equipped with a memory stop mechanism.It is equipped with output level control which is linked with volume control of headphone.Equipped with timer play / rec mechanism. By connecting a timer sold separately, it is possible to record your absence and play an alarm.The Pause/Mute mechanism is used to combine the Rec Mute and Pause to improve operability.When recording, press and hold the Rec button to mute, release it to pause, and press the Play button again to record.Equipped with a follow-up recording mechanism, you can change from a regenerating condition with the tape running to a recording state with one touch operation.Equipped with remote control terminal and separately sold remote control unit RC-57 can be used."

description:
## Description

"This is a cassette deck that uses the highly reliable mechanism originally developed by Denon and Dolby HX Pro.The mechanism uses a highly reliable rotary encoder 2-motor + 1-motor computer-controlled silent mechanism. This mechanism uses a newly developed microcomputer for driving the mechanism that integrates the mechanical drive and counter display control into a single chip, and realizes smooth and silent operation.The basic structure consists of a DC-servo motor for the capstan and a high-torque, low-ripple DC-motor for the reel motor. The capstan and high-precision zinc-die-cast flywheel have been specially treated to increase the friction coefficient. By reducing torque fluctuation (cocking) and running loss, the wow flutter and other basic features are enhanced.The recording / reproducing head uses SF Hyperbolic Hard Permalloy R/P head.This head reduces the contour effect at low frequencies by making the core part that touches the tape a hyperboloid shape.The amplifier section uses a newly developed DC amplifier LSI for the cassette deck. This LSI consists of a left and right channel playback amplifier and a recording amplifier on a single chip. This LSI eliminates differences in L/R characteristics and sound quality, while reducing noise and power consumption.The playback equalizer amplifier has a much higher open gain in the high-frequency band than the conventional operational amplifier and realizes low distortion over the entire frequency band. The amplifier also has a high S/N and a wide dynamic range by greatly reducing the noise level generated in the amplifier. In addition, the quality is enhanced by the DC configuration without the input coupling capacitor.The C. C. D. C. (Constant Current Drive Circuit) is used in the recording amplifier section to eliminate output resistance, and there is no phase shift even in response to the impedance change of the head due to the recording frequency, realizing a wide dynamic range and low distortion factor.In addition, direct coupling between the head and the recording amplifier eliminates sound quality degradation during recording.The power supply is composed of ¥2 power supplies.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro.The Dolby HX Pro eliminates over-bias, which has been a problem with the conventional fixed bias method. When the input signal contains many high-frequency components during recording, the bias amount from the oscillator is automatically reduced. This greatly improves high-frequency characteristics and reduces distortion over the entire band. In addition, since the effective bias value is always constant even when the impedance of the head changes due to temperature changes or other factors, there is no degradation in high-frequency characteristics even during long-term recording.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.The Dolby circuit uses a newly developed symmetrical one chip LSI for left and right channels.The Bias Fine control allows you to fine-tune the recording bias amount.The display is equipped with a 4-digit digital counter with a memory stop function, a bar graph peak meter of + 8 dB to -20dB, and various indicators such as operation status, tape position and memory stop.Equipped with a memory stop function.Equipped with an auto tape selector, it automatically identifies each tape when it is set and automatically sets the bias / equalizer.Equipped with an MPX filter switch, it can prevent Dolby NR malfunction by cutting the 19 kHz pilot signal included in FM radio waves.It uses a Pause/Mute mechanism to combine the pause and mute functions.In recording mode, press the Pause/Mute button (within 0.5 seconds) to create a recording pause. Press and hold the button for 1 second or longer to create a 5-second unrecorded portion and make a recording pause.A one touch rec-pause mechanism is adopted, and recording standby can be performed only by pressing the Rec button.Equipped with a balanced volume.Equipped with a Timer Play-Rec mechanism. By connecting a timer sold separately, it is possible to record your absence or play an alarm.Wireless remote control is included."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"This stereo cassette deck has been designed to further improve sound quality by using an anti-vibration structure.The top cover has a double-layered structure with another sheet of steel attached to the inside of the top plate. The bottom plate uses a bi-breath bottom plate composed of three layers of steel plate and plastic film. This plate has an extremely high vibration absorption effect and is also used in Denon CD players.In addition, the capstan motor is mounted on a 1.6 mm thick mechanical base with low repulsion rubber for a floating structure, and a large sintered alloy insulator with excellent vibration absorption effect is used for the leg part.The tape travel mechanism employs a closed-loop dual capstan system using Denon's exclusive drive belt system. This system eliminates disturbance caused by minute vibration of the reel and various factors between the two capstan pairs, greatly reducing modulation noise and ensuring excellent head touch at all times.The capstan motor uses an electronically controlled DC-motor with strong torque and no torque fluctuation, and a flywheel with a large moment of inertia on the take-up side to achieve excellent wow and flutter characteristics.A computer-controlled silent mechanism using a highly reliable rotary encoder has been adopted for the running system.This system consists of optical rotation detection, a unique rotor encoder for position detection, and a motor for mechanical control (cam drive). All of these are controlled by a microcomputer, so that tape position detection and drive mode confirmation can be done quickly and accurately.In addition, in order to ensure the total quality of tape travel, a DC motor and a non-slip reel drive mechanism are adopted for the take-up mechanism, making it possible to obtain the optimum tape tension at all times. In addition, since there is no mechanical friction between the half and the take-up reel stand, there is no noise when the tape is taken up, and tape travel is not adversely affected. Moreover, since there is no friction point, the durability of the mechanism is improved.Equipped with a mechanism to prevent the cassette tape from loosening.An SF combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head uses a super-permalloy core with a high saturation flux density to maximize the MOL of the tape and improve abrasion resistance. The reproducing head uses a fine-grained ferrite core with excellent high-frequency characteristics and abrasion resistance to reduce fluctuations in magnetic characteristics due to sliding noise and temperature changes. The coil uses an oxygen-free copper wire (OFC) to reduce distortion.By combining these heads with high precision, we have greatly improved the misalignment of the azimuth between the recording and reproducing heads and the head mount adjustment.The erasing head uses a double-gap ferrite head with a high erasing effect.The power transformer is located as far away from the head as possible to prevent the influence of noise and is mounted on the chassis via a plate to eliminate the influence of vibration. The secondary side of the transformer completely separates the amplifier circuit and logic / mechanical circuit to eliminate the influence of noise.The recording amplifier uses a single-chip LSI developed specifically for the deck to ensure the same characteristics for the left and right channels and high stability. In addition, the recording amplifier uses a C. C. D. C. (Constant Current Drive Circuit) to eliminate the change in the head current due to the change in recording frequency by eliminating the output resistance, thereby increasing the dynamic range and realizing a low distortion factor.A low-noise IC is used for the playback amplifier to improve the S/N ratio.Each of the recording and playback amplifiers is directly connected to the head, eliminating the coupling capacitor that can degrade sound quality.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro.The Dolby HX Pro eliminates over-bias, which has been a problem with the conventional fixed bias method. When the input signal contains many high-frequency components during recording, the bias amount from the oscillator is automatically reduced. This greatly improves high-frequency characteristics and reduces distortion over the entire band. In addition, since the effective bias value is always constant even when the impedance of the head changes due to temperature changes or other factors, there is no degradation in high-frequency characteristics even during long-term recording.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.The Dolby circuit uses a newly developed symmetrical one chip LSI for the left and right channels. In addition, the DR-M27HX has a double Dolby configuration in which the Dolby IC is separated into a recording circuit and a reproducing circuit, so that the Dolby effect can be confirmed even during after-monitoring (simultaneous playback).Equipped with a REC calibration control function, the recording sensitivity of various types of tapes can be adjusted by adjusting the tape and source levels using the recording calibration signal of the FM tuner or the single-tone signal of the test record.Bias Fine also allows you to fine-tune the amount of recording bias.The display is equipped with a 4-digit digital counter with a memory stop function, a bar graph peak meter of + 8 dB to -20dB, and various indicators such as operation status, tape position and memory stop.Equipped with a memory stop function.Equipped with an auto tape selector, it automatically identifies each tape when it is set and automatically sets the bias / equalizer.Equipped with an MPX filter switch, it can prevent Dolby NR malfunction by cutting the 19 kHz pilot signal included in FM radio waves.It uses a Pause/Mute mechanism to combine the pause and mute functions.In recording mode, press the Pause/Mute button (within 0.5 seconds) to create a recording pause. Press and hold the button for 1 second or longer to create a 5-second unrecorded portion and make a recording pause.A one touch rec-pause mechanism is adopted, and recording standby can be performed only by pressing the Rec button.Equipped with a follow-up recording function, you can move from the running state of the tape during playback to the recording state as it is.Equipped with a balanced volume.Equipped with a Timer Play-Rec mechanism. By connecting a timer sold separately, it is possible to record your absence or play an alarm.Wireless remote control is included."

name: DENON
description:
## Description

"Cassette deck with horizontal loading mechanism.A tray type horizontal loading mechanism is adopted.By mounting the deck mechanism horizontally, vibration in the thrust direction of the flywheel is suppressed and modulation noise is reduced. In addition to the use of ceramic composite for the cassette tray, a 4-motor configuration with motors for the reel, capstan, head lifting / lowering, and loading realizes stable tape travel and smooth operation without rotational unevenness by using a 4-motor configuration.The mechanism section employs a computer-controlled silent mechanism using a closed-loop dual capstan system.In the closed-loop dual capstan system, disturbance such as vibration of the reel is cut off between two sets of capstan, and modulation noise caused by vibration of the tape is greatly reduced, and smooth head touch and quiet driving force are always obtained.In the silent mechanism, the mechanism control and counter display function are controlled by a microcomputer integrated into one chip, and smooth operation is achieved. Even if the power is turned off during recording or playback, the pinch roller returns to the STOP position to prevent damage to the tape. In addition, the pinch roller rises very quickly after pressing the REC button, and it is strong in recording timing.The capstan motor uses an electronically controlled DC-motor with strong torque and no rotational irregularities, while the take-up capstan uses a fly-wheel with a large moment of inertia, greatly reducing wow and flutter.Equipped with a non-slip reel drive mechanism to always maintain the optimum tension of the tape.In addition, since there is no mechanical friction between the motor and the take-up reel stand, there is no noise or aging change when the tape is taken up, and uniform constant speed running from the beginning to the end of the tape is possible.A cassette stabilizer (C. C. C. S) made of ceramic composite and a cassette tray (C. C. C. T) are used in order to reduce vibration and modulation noise of the cassette half during tape travel. This ensures stable tape travel.A combination head using single-crystal oxygen-free copper (PC-OCC) wire with less signal degradation has been adopted for the read / write head to improve high-frequency characteristics and MOL characteristics.In addition, the head base is made of aluminum die-cast, and by fixing it firmly without interfering with the movement of the head, unnecessary vibration and aberration of azimuth are suppressed.A DC amplifier configuration is used for the playback / recording amplifier section.The L/R channel amplifier is integrated into a single chip IC for the playback equalizer amplifier to greatly reduce the noise level generated in the amplifier section. In addition, by connecting the playback head and the amplifier directly and eliminating the coupling capacitor, the degradation of low-frequency characteristics is eliminated.The power supply section is composed of ¥2 power supplies to increase the saturation level of the amplifier section and obtain a wide dynamic range.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro.This function automatically adjusts the bias level to the optimum value to prevent over-bias in the high frequency range.Equipped with a Dolby B/C type noise reduction system.Equipped with an auto tape selector, it automatically detects the set tape position and sets it according to type I (normal), II (high position) and IV (metal).Equipped with an auto tape monitor.This function automatically monitors the recorded sound when it is set to Play or RecPlay (Rec Mute). It switches to Source when the tape is not running.Equipped with Rec Return function.The recording start position is memorized by the computer, and when the Rec return key is pressed, it automatically returns to the original start position and enters the standby state.Equipped with an FL peak level meter that can display from -40dB to + 10 dB.This meter is equipped with a peak hold function.Equipped with a manual bias control function, the bias fine volume allows you to fine-tune the optimum recording bias value for each tape, which may vary slightly.Equipped with a linear time digital counter that can display the remaining amount of tape.This counter is equipped with a tape size selector and memory stop mechanism.Equipped with Music Search.Equipped with a slack prevention mechanism.Equipped with a follow-up recording function.Equipped with an auto recording space function, you can make a 4-second space between songs.It is equipped with an MPX filter switch to prevent malfunction of the Dolby system by cutting off the 19 khz pilot signal of the FM signal. The filter is automatically disabled when Dolby B/C Noise Reduction is not used.Wireless remote control is included."
